+/** Real scrollport geometry, wheel/trackpad input, scrollbar drag, and touch.
+ * Both the desktop checkout and the tablet cart drawer use this contract. */
+async function cashierScroll(panel, { lang, name, height, touch = false }) {
+  await panel.evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = 0; });
+  const start = await panel.evaluate((el) => {
+    const cart = el.querySelector('[data-testid="pos-cart"]');
+    const payment = el.lastElementChild;
+    return {
+      overflow: getComputedStyle(el).overflowY,
+      rect: el.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),
+      cart: cart.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),
+      payment: payment.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),
+      clientHeight: el.clientHeight,
+      scrollHeight: el.scrollHeight,
+      clientWidth: el.clientWidth,
+      scrollWidth: el.scrollWidth,
+      scrollbarWidth: el.offsetWidth - el.clientWidth,
+    };
+  });
+  assert.equal(start.overflow, 'auto', `${name}: checkout is the scroll container`);
+  assert.ok(start.clientHeight > 0 && start.scrollHeight > start.clientHeight + 10, `${name}: checkout must actually overflow`);
+  assert.ok(start.cart.height >= 300, `${name}: cart/customer/discount must not collapse behind payment`);
+  assert.ok(start.payment.top >= start.cart.bottom + 10, `${name}: payment must not overlap cart`);
+  assert.ok(start.rect.bottom <= height + 1, `${name}: scrollport must end above the viewport bottom`);
+  assert.ok(start.scrollWidth <= start.clientWidth + 2, `${name}: no sideways cashier scroll`);
+  assert.ok(start.scrollbarWidth >= 8, `${name}: visible scrollbar can be dragged`);
+  if (await panel.getAttribute('data-testid') === 'pos-checkout-panel') {
+    assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight <= Math.max(
+      innerHeight, innerWidth < 1280 ? 680 : 632,
+    ) + 1), `${name}: expanding payment or the cart must not force additional document scrolling`);
+  }
+
+  const beforeWindowY = await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollY);
+  const box = await panel.boundingBox();
+  // Point at the payment area, not the nested cart-line list: the wheel must
+  // scroll checkout rather than accidentally selecting a second scrollport.
+  await page.mouse.move(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height - 30);
+  await page.mouse.wheel(0, 5000);
+  await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((el) => el.scrollTop)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((el) => Math.abs(el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop))).toBeLessThan(2);
+  const complete = await panel.evaluate((el, language) => {
+    const label = language === 'ar' ? 'إتمام البيع' : 'Complete sale';
+    const button = [...el.querySelectorAll('button')].find((item) => item.textContent.includes(label));
+    const pane = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const rect = button?.getBoundingClientRect();
+    return rect && { top: rect.top, bottom: rect.bottom, paneTop: pane.top, paneBottom: pane.bottom };
+  }, lang);
+  assert.ok(complete && complete.top >= complete.paneTop - 1 && complete.bottom <= complete.paneBottom + 1,
+    `${name}: Complete sale is reachable at the bottom of checkout`);
+  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollY), beforeWindowY, `${name}: wheel did not move the whole page`);
+
+  // Chrome's headless default hides scrollbars, so the launch above explicitly
+  // enables them. Drag the thumb on the right in LTR or left in RTL.
+  await panel.evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = 0; });
+  const thumbX = lang === 'ar' ? box.x + 5 : box.x + box.width - 5;
+  await page.mouse.move(thumbX, box.y + 30);
+  await page.mouse.down();
+  await page.mouse.move(thumbX, box.y + box.height - 30, { steps: 10 });
+  await page.mouse.up();
+  await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((el) => el.scrollTop)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+
+  if (touch) {
+    await panel.evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = 0; });
+    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
+    await cdp.send('Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled', { enabled: true, maxTouchPoints: 1 });
+    try {
+      const x = box.x + box.width / 2;
+      const y = box.y + box.height - 35;
+      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchStart', touchPoints: [{ x, y }] });
+      for (let step = 1; step <= 14; step += 1) {
+        await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchMove', touchPoints: [{ x, y: y - step * 32 }] });
+        await page.waitForTimeout(15);
+      }
+      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchEnd', touchPoints: [] });
+      await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((el) => el.scrollTop)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    } finally {
+      await cdp.send('Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled', { enabled: false });
+      await cdp.detach();
+    }
+    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollY), beforeWindowY, `${name}: touch stays inside checkout`);
+  }
+  console.log(`✓ ${name}: wheel/trackpad, thumb drag${touch ? ', touch' : ''}, bottom controls reachable`);

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/** Phase 4B source-boundary check. No generated files, public test routes or
+ * database access: compare the shipped entry graph with the registered
+ * test-only rollback projection using the same esbuild recipe as the suites.
+ * Metafile inputs over-approximate shipped code (they include parsed but later
+ * tree-shaken modules); absence is nevertheless proof of no import edge.
+ */
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { build } from "esbuild";
+import { testBuildOptions, testPlugins } from "./lib/app-bundle.mjs";
+import { legacyStoreRollbackPlugin } from "./lib/legacy-store-rollback.plugin.mjs";
+
+const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
+const pages = ["StoreHomePage", "StoreProductsPage", "StoreProductPage", "StoreCartPage",
+  "StoreCheckoutPage", "StoreConfirmationPage", "StoreTrackPage", "StoreAccountPage",
+  "StoreAboutPage", "StoreContactPage"];
+const legacyOnly = [
+  ...pages.map((page) => `src/modules/online/pages/${page}.tsx`),
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/StoreLayout.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/ProductCard.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/VariantPicker.tsx",
+];
+const shared = [
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/SocialIcon.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/PaymentProofPanel.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/components/storefront/StorePrimitives.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/components/admin/StorefrontPreview.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/hooks/StorefrontProvider.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/hooks/StoreCartProvider.tsx",
+  "src/modules/online/hooks/StoreAccountProvider.tsx",
+];
+const active = ["StorefrontV2Home", "StorefrontV2Catalog", "StorefrontV2Product",
+  "StorefrontV2Cart", "StorefrontV2Checkout", "StorefrontV2Confirmation",
+  "StorefrontV2Track", "StorefrontV2Account", "StorefrontV2About", "StorefrontV2Contact",
+  "StorefrontV2PreviewRedirect", "StorefrontV2Shell"].map((name) =>
+  `src/modules/online/v2/${name}.tsx`);
+
+async function inputs(rollback) {
+  const entry = path.join(root, "src/main.tsx");
+  const outfile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), rollback ? "alyq-4b-rollback-audit.mjs" : "alyq-4b-public-audit.mjs");
+  const result = await build(testBuildOptions({ entryPoints: [entry], outfile,
+    write: false, metafile: true,
+    ...(rollback ? { plugins: [legacyStoreRollbackPlugin(), ...testPlugins()] } : {}),
+  }));
+  return new Set(Object.keys(result.metafile.inputs).map((input) =>
+    path.relative(root, path.resolve(root, input)).split(path.sep).join("/")));
+}
+
+const [publicInputs, rollbackInputs] = await Promise.all([inputs(false), inputs(true)]);
+for (const file of legacyOnly) {
+  assert.ok(!publicInputs.has(file), `Legacy presentation imported by public bundle: ${file}`);
+  assert.ok(rollbackInputs.has(file), `Rollback regression lost its legacy dependency: ${file}`);
+}
+for (const file of shared) {
+  assert.ok(publicInputs.has(file), `Shared V2/Admin dependency missing from public bundle: ${file}`);
+}
+for (const file of active) {
+  assert.ok(publicInputs.has(file), `Canonical V2 route/shell absent from public bundle: ${file}`);
+}
+assert.ok(publicInputs.has("src/modules/online/pages/StoreContentPage.tsx"),
+  "The back-office content editor is not a legacy shopper page");
+console.log(`Public: ${publicInputs.size} graph inputs; rollback tests: ${rollbackInputs.size} graph inputs.`);
+console.log(`PASS: ${legacyOnly.length} retained legacy presentation modules are excluded from the public import graph and present in the test-only rollback graph.`);
+console.log(`PASS: ${shared.length} shared/Admin dependencies and ${active.length} canonical V2 routes/shell modules remain public.`);

+function ColorOverride({ field, label, value, inherited, onChange }: {
+  field: V2ColorField;
+  label: string;
+  value: string | null;
+  inherited: string;
+  onChange: (next: string | null) => void;
+}) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const valid = value === null || Boolean(safeV2Color(value, ""));
+  const fallback = safeV2Color(inherited, "#202427");
+  const forPicker = safeV2Color(value, fallback);
+  const pickerHex = forPicker.length === 4 ? `#${[...forPicker.slice(1)].map((char) => char + char).join("")}` : forPicker;
+  return <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3" data-testid={`v2-color-${field}`}>
+    <label htmlFor={`v2-hex-${field}`} className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">{label}</label>
+    <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
+      <input type="color" value={pickerHex} aria-label={`${label} — ${t("online.v2.picker")}`}
+        className="h-10 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white p-1"
+        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} />
+      <TextInput id={`v2-hex-${field}`} data-testid={`v2-hex-${field}`} dir="ltr"
+        value={value ?? ""} placeholder={fallback} aria-invalid={!valid}
+        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} className="min-w-0 font-mono text-xs" />
+      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={value === null} onClick={() => onChange(null)}
+        aria-label={`${t("online.v2.inherit")} ${label}`}>{t("online.v2.resetField")}</Button>
+    </div>
+    {value === null ? <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] text-slate-500">{t("online.v2.inherited")}: {fallback}</span> : null}
+    {!valid ? <span role="alert" className="mt-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700">
+      {t("online.v2.invalidColor")}</span> : null}
+  </div>;
+}

+      <h3 className="mt-2 text-sm font-black text-slate-900">{title}</h3>
+      {hint ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">{hint}</p> : null}</div>
+    {children}
+  </Card>;
+}

+/** V2 colour overrides must be opaque to allow reliable contrast calculation. */
+export function safeV2Color(value: unknown, fallback: string): string {
+  return typeof value === "string" && /^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(value.trim())
+    ? value.trim() : fallback;
+}

+export function invalidSettingsColor(settings: WebsiteSettings): string | null {
+  for (const field of THEME_COLOR_FIELDS) {
+    if (!isHexColor(settings.theme[field])) return field;
+  }
+  for (const field of ["bg_color", "text_color"] as const) {
+    const value = settings.announcement[field];
+    if (value && !isHexColor(value)) return `announcement.${field}`;
+  }
+  for (const field of V2_COLOR_FIELDS) {
+    const value = settings.storefront_v2?.[field];
+    if (value !== null && value !== undefined && safeV2Color(value, "") === "") {
+      return `storefront_v2.${field}`;
+    }
+  }
+  return null;

+/** Shared website social/contact link policy. No new CMS or phone-identity logic:
+ * a shopper-facing WhatsApp destination needs an explicit international code,
+ * and a profile link must actually lead to its named service. */
+import type { SocialPlatform, WebsiteSettings } from "../types";
+
+type ProfilePlatform = Exclude<SocialPlatform, "whatsapp">;
+const PROFILE_HOSTS: Record<ProfilePlatform, readonly string[]> = {
+  facebook: ["facebook.com", "www.facebook.com", "m.facebook.com", "web.facebook.com", "fb.com", "www.fb.com"],
+  instagram: ["instagram.com", "www.instagram.com"],
+  tiktok: ["tiktok.com", "www.tiktok.com", "m.tiktok.com"],
+};
+
+/** Reject lookalike hosts, credentials, HTTP, executable schemes and empty
+ * service homepages. URL() only runs after the literal HTTPS check. */
+export function socialProfileHref(platform: ProfilePlatform, raw: unknown): string | null {
+  if (typeof raw !== "string") return null;
+  const value = raw.trim();
+  if (value.length > 500 || !/^https:\/\//i.test(value) || /[\s\\]/.test(value) ||
+    [...value].some((char) => char.charCodeAt(0) === 127)) return null;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(value);
+    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || url.port || url.hash ||
+      !PROFILE_HOSTS[platform].includes(url.hostname) || url.pathname === "/") return null;
+    if (platform === "instagram" && !/^\/[a-z\d._]+\/?$/i.test(url.pathname)) return null;
+    if (platform === "tiktok" && !/^\/@[a-z\d._]+\/?$/i.test(url.pathname)) return null;
+    return url.href;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+/** `wa.me` URLs already saved by older shops can still be edited. New input
+ * may be +CC (or 00CC) with spaces/brackets/dashes, or an existing bare E.164
+ * number. A local 0… number is *not* silently prefixed with Egypt's code. */
+function whatsappUrl(raw: string): URL | null {
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(raw);
+    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname !== "wa.me" || url.username || url.password || url.port || url.hash ||
+      !/^\/[1-9]\d{7,14}\/?$/.test(url.pathname) ||
+      [...url.searchParams.keys()].some((key) => key !== "text") || [...url.searchParams.keys()].length > 1 ||
+      !validWhatsAppMessage(url.searchParams.get("text") ?? "")) return null;
+    return url;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+export function normalizeWhatsAppPhone(raw: unknown): string | null {
+  if (typeof raw !== "string") return null;
+  const value = raw.trim();
+  if (!value || value.length > 500 || value.includes("\\") ||
+    [...value].some((char) => char.charCodeAt(0) < 32 || char.charCodeAt(0) === 127)) return null;
+  let digits: string;
+  let explicitCode: boolean;
+  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) {
+    const url = whatsappUrl(value);
+    if (!url) return null;
+    digits = url.pathname.slice(1).replace(/\/$/, "");
+    explicitCode = true;
+  } else {
+    if (!/^\+?[0-9][0-9 ()-]*$/.test(value) || value.startsWith("+00") ||
+      // Stray/misordered brackets are not mere presentation characters.
+      value.replace(/\([^()]*\)/g, "").includes("(") || value.replace(/\([^()]*\)/g, "").includes(")")) return null;
+    explicitCode = value.startsWith("+") || value.startsWith("00");
+    digits = value.replace(/[ ()-]/g, "").replace(/^\+/, "").replace(/^00/, "");
+  }
+  // +20 (0)100... explicitly supplies Egypt's code and a redundant trunk 0.
+  if (/^2001\d{9}$/.test(digits)) digits = `20${digits.slice(3)}`;
+  if (!/^[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(digits)) return null;
+  if (!explicitCode && digits.length < 11) return null;
+  if (digits.startsWith("20") && !/^201\d{9}$/.test(digits)) return null;
+  return digits;
+}
+
+/** Plain bilingual copy, not HTML. The length cap keeps generated links within
+ * practical browser limits; encodeURIComponent is guarded against bad UTF-16. */
+export function validWhatsAppMessage(raw: unknown): raw is string {
+  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length > 800 || [...raw].some((char) => {
+    const code = char.codePointAt(0)!;
+    return code === 127 || (code < 32 && code !== 9 && code !== 10 && code !== 13);
+  })) return false;
+  try { encodeURIComponent(raw); return true; } catch { return false; }
+}
+
+export function whatsappChannelHref(raw: unknown, message = ""): string | null {
+  const number = normalizeWhatsAppPhone(raw);
+  if (!number || !validWhatsAppMessage(message)) return null;
+  // A previously saved wa.me?text=… keeps its existing copy unless the owner
+  // enters a new message in the shared Social editor.
+  const legacyCopy = typeof raw === "string" && /^https:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())
+    ? whatsappUrl(raw.trim())?.searchParams.get("text") ?? "" : "";
+  const text = message.trim() || legacyCopy.trim();
+  return `https://wa.me/${number}${text ? `?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}` : ""}`;
+}
+
+export function socialChannelHref(platform: SocialPlatform, raw: unknown, message = ""): string | null {
+  return platform === "whatsapp" ? whatsappChannelHref(raw, message) : socialProfileHref(platform, raw);
+}
+
+export type SocialFieldError = {
+  platform: SocialPlatform;
+  field: "url" | "message";
+  reason: "invalid" | "required";
+};
+
+/** The Admin validates the *whole draft* before writing one settings row. The
+ * legacy flat fields and the enabled rows both matter: neither may smuggle an
+ * unsafe or wrongly branded URL through the other editor. Disabled accounts
+ * may retain valid values for re-enabling, but enabled rows need a destination. */
+export function invalidSocialSetting(settings: WebsiteSettings): SocialFieldError | null {
+  for (const platform of ["facebook", "instagram", "tiktok", "whatsapp"] as const) {
+    const flat = settings.social[platform];
+    const row = settings.social_links.find((entry) => entry.platform === platform);
+    if (flat && !socialChannelHref(platform, flat)) return { platform, field: "url", reason: "invalid" };
+    if (row?.url && !socialChannelHref(platform, row.url)) return { platform, field: "url", reason: "invalid" };
+    if (row?.enabled && !(row.url?.trim() || flat?.trim())) return { platform, field: "url", reason: "required" };
+    if (platform === "whatsapp" && row &&
+      (!validWhatsAppMessage(row.message_ar ?? "") || !validWhatsAppMessage(row.message_en ?? ""))) {
+      return { platform, field: "message", reason: "invalid" };
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}

+/** Coupon checks and breakdowns are advisory. The single shared cart/provider
+ * owns apply/remove, and the placement RPC recomputes the actual discount. */
+export function V2Coupon() {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { couponCode, couponInput, setCouponInput, couponError, applyingCoupon,
+    applyCoupon, clearCoupon, preview } = useStoreCart();
+  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(couponInput);
+  const current = couponCode ?? preview?.promoCode;
+  return <div className="v2-coupon" data-testid="v2-coupon">
+    <label htmlFor="v2-coupon-code">{t("store.cart.coupon")}</label>
+    {current ? <div className="v2-coupon-applied"><strong>{current}</strong>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => { clearCoupon(); setDraft(""); }}>
+        {t("store.cart.removeCoupon")}</button></div> : <div className="v2-coupon-entry">
+      <input id="v2-coupon-code" autoComplete="off" value={draft} placeholder={t("store.cart.couponPlaceholder")}
+        onChange={(event) => { setDraft(event.target.value); setCouponInput(event.target.value); }}
+        onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); void applyCoupon(draft); } }} />
+      <button type="button" className="v2-outline-button" disabled={applyingCoupon || !draft.trim()}
+        onClick={() => void applyCoupon(draft)}>{applyingCoupon ? t("common.loading") : t("store.cart.applyCoupon")}</button>
+    </div>}
+    {couponError && !couponCode ? <p role="alert" className="v2-field-error">{t(`store.coupon.${couponError}` as never)}</p> : null}
+    {current && !couponError ? <p role="status" className="v2-field-success">{t("store.coupon.applied")}</p> : null}
+    <p className="v2-small">{t("store.v2.journey.advisoryCoupon")}</p>
+  </div>;
+}

+export function V2CartTotals({ showDelivery = false }: { showDelivery?: boolean }) {
+  const { t, pick, money } = useI18n();
+  const { settings } = useStorefront();
+  const { totals, preview, previewLoading, deliveryType, deliveryZoneId, freeDelivery } = useStoreCart();
+  const zone = useStorefront().deliveryZones.find((entry) => entry.id === deliveryZoneId && entry.enabled);
+  const shown = preview;
+  return <div data-testid="v2-cart-totals">
+    <dl className="v2-totals">
+      <div><dt>{t("store.cart.subtotal")}</dt><dd>{money(shown?.subtotal ?? totals.subtotal)}</dd></div>
+      {(shown?.autoDiscount ?? 0) > 0 ? <div className="v2-totals-discount"><dt>
+        {t("store.checkout.productDiscounts")}{shown?.autoPromotionName ? ` · ${shown.autoPromotionName}` : ""}
+      </dt><dd>−{money(shown?.autoDiscount ?? 0)}</dd></div> : null}
+      {(shown?.promoDiscount ?? totals.discount_amount) > 0 ? <div className="v2-totals-discount"><dt>
+        {t("store.cart.discount")}{shown?.promoCode ?? totals.discount_code ? ` · ${shown?.promoCode ?? totals.discount_code}` : ""}
+      </dt><dd>−{money(shown?.promoDiscount ?? totals.discount_amount)}</dd></div> : null}
+      {showDelivery ? <div><dt>{deliveryType === "pickup" ? t("store.checkout.pickup") :
+        zone ? pick(zone.name_ar, zone.name_en) : t("store.cart.deliveryFee")}</dt>
+        <dd>{(shown?.deliveryFee ?? totals.delivery_fee) > 0
+          ? money(shown?.deliveryFee ?? totals.delivery_fee) : t("store.checkout.free")}</dd></div> : null}
+      {showDelivery && (shown?.shippingDiscount ?? 0) > 0 ? <div className="v2-totals-discount"><dt>
+        {t("store.checkout.deliveryDiscount")}</dt><dd>−{money(shown?.shippingDiscount ?? 0)}</dd></div> : null}
+      <div className="v2-totals-grand"><dt>{t("store.cart.total")}</dt>
+        <dd>{money(shown?.total ?? totals.total)}</dd></div>
+    </dl>
+    {freeDelivery && deliveryType === "delivery" && !freeDelivery.eligible ?
+      <p className="v2-small">{t("store.cart.freeDeliveryRemaining", { amount: money(freeDelivery.remaining) })}</p> : null}
+    {previewLoading ? <p className="v2-small" role="status">{t("store.v2.journey.checkingPrices")}</p> : null}
+    <p className="v2-small">{t("store.v2.journey.advisoryTotal")}{settings.delivery.enabled && !zone &&
+      deliveryType === "delivery" ? ` · ${t("store.v2.journey.zoneEstimate")}` : ""}</p>
+  </div>;

+/** Preserve the exact, battle-tested upload/reference state machine. Token
+ * aliases are confined to this wrapper; no second proof or payment backend. */
+export function V2ProofPanel({ order }: { order: OnlineOrder }) {
+  const { settings } = useStorefront();
+  if (order.payment_method !== "instapay" || order.payment_status === "paid" ||
+    !settings.delivery.instapay_proof_required) return null;
+  const tokens = {
+    "--store-primary": "var(--v2-button-bg)", "--store-on-primary": "var(--v2-button-text)",
+    "--store-primary-soft": "var(--v2-bg)", "--store-border": "var(--v2-border)",
+    "--store-surface": "var(--v2-surface)", "--store-text-primary": "var(--v2-surface-text)",
+    "--store-text-secondary": "var(--v2-surface-muted)",
+    "--store-radius": "var(--v2-card-radius)", "--store-radius-button": "var(--v2-button-radius)",
+  } as CSSProperties;
+  return <div className="v2-proof" style={tokens} data-testid="v2-payment-proof">
+    <PaymentProofPanel key={`${order.id}:${order.payment_reference ?? ""}`} orderNumber={order.order_number}
+      phone={order.customer_phone} total={order.total}
+      submitted={order.payment_submitted_at !== null && order.payment_status !== "failed"}
+      storedReference={order.payment_reference} />
+  </div>;
+}

+/** The same lightweight, local icon set serves the real V2 shell and the
+ * Admin's inert appearance sample. No uploaded SVG or icon-font requests. */
+export type V2IconName = "menu" | "search" | "user" | "bag" | "close" | "arrow";
+export function V2Icon({ name }: { name: V2IconName }) {
+  const paths: Record<V2IconName, ReactNode> = {
+    menu: <><path d="M3 7h18M3 12h18M3 17h18" /></>,
+    search: <><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.5" /><path d="m16 16 5 5" /></>,
+    user: <><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3.4" /><path d="M5 21c.1-4 2.5-6 7-6s6.9 2 7 6" /></>,
+    bag: <><path d="M4.5 8h15l1 13h-17l1-13ZM9 9V6a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v3" /></>,
+    close: <><path d="M5 5l14 14M19 5 5 19" /></>,
+    arrow: <><path d="M4 12h16m-7-7 7 7-7 7" /></>,
+  };
+  return <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.55"
+    strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{paths[name]}</svg>;
+}

+/** Safe configured CTA: canonical shop URLs render directly; old saved preview
+ * URLs are normalised, and other validated destinations retain their policy. */
+export function V2ActionLink({ href, children, className = "" }: {
+  href: string | null | undefined;
+  children: ReactNode;
+  className?: string;
+}) {
+  const to = v2Href(href);
+  if (!to) return null;
+  if (to.startsWith("/")) return <Link to={to} className={className}>{children}</Link>;
+  return <a href={to} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className={className}>{children}</a>;
+}

+/** No bundled V2 photography: every URL is from ALYQ product/content/settings. */
+export function V2Image({ src, mobileSrc, alt, priority = false, className = "", fit = "cover" }: {
+  src?: string | null;
+  mobileSrc?: string | null;
+  alt: string;
+  priority?: boolean;
+  className?: string;
+  fit?: "cover" | "contain";
+}) {
+  const [brokenSrc, setBrokenSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const selected = src || mobileSrc || null;
+  const failed = brokenSrc === selected;
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  return (
+    <span className={`v2-image ${className}`} data-testid="v2-image">
+      {selected && !failed ? (
+        <picture>
+          {mobileSrc && src ? <source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcSet={mobileSrc} /> : null}
+          <img
+            src={selected}
+            alt={alt}
+            loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
+            decoding="async"
+            style={{ objectFit: fit }}
+            onError={() => setBrokenSrc(selected)}
+          />
+        </picture>
+      ) : (
+        <span className="v2-image-fallback" role="img" aria-label={alt || t("store.v2.imageMissing")}>
+          <span aria-hidden>◇</span>
+          <small>{t("store.v2.imageMissing")}</small>
+        </span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+export function V2Price({ price, className = "" }: {
+  price: { price: number; list: number; from: boolean };
+  className?: string;
+}) {
+  const { t, money } = useI18n();
+  return <p className={`v2-price ${className}`}>

+export function V2Status({ available, mode, tracked = true, chosen = true }: {
+  available: number | null;
+  mode: "demo" | "supabase";
+  tracked?: boolean;
+  chosen?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  if (!tracked) return <span className="v2-stock v2-stock-out">{t("store.v2.notOrderable")}</span>;
+  if (!chosen) return <span className="v2-stock">{t("store.v2.pleaseChoose")}</span>;
+  if (available === null) return null;
+  if (available <= 0) return <span className="v2-stock v2-stock-out">{t("store.product.outOfStock")}</span>;
+  if (available <= 5) return <span className="v2-stock v2-stock-limited">{mode === "demo"
+    ? t("store.product.onlyLeft", { count: available })
+    : t("store.v2.limited")}</span>;
+  return <span className="v2-stock">{t("store.product.inStock")}</span>;
+}

+export function V2State({ kind, onRetry }: { kind: "loading" | "error" | "empty"; onRetry?: () => void }) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  if (kind === "loading") return (
+    <div className="v2-state v2-skeleton-row" role="status" aria-label={t("common.loading")} data-testid="v2-loading">
+      <div /><div /><div /><div />
+    </div>
+  );
+  return (
+    <div className="v2-state" role={kind === "error" ? "alert" : "status"} data-testid={`v2-${kind}`}>
+      <p>{t(kind === "error" ? "store.v2.error" : "store.v2.empty")}</p>
+      {kind === "error" && onRetry ? (
+        <button type="button" className="v2-outline-button" onClick={onRetry}>{t("store.v2.retry")}</button>
+      ) : null}

+import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
+import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { variantMatchesCatalogFilters, type CatalogFilters, type CatalogProduct } from "../services/catalogQuery";
+import type { StoreVariant } from "../services/pricing";
+import { campaignBadgeText } from "../services/badges";
+import { variantColorLabel } from "../services/variantLabel";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { useStoreCart } from "../hooks/StoreCartProvider";
+import { useStoreAccount } from "../hooks/StoreAccountProvider";
+import { V2Image, V2Status } from "./Primitives";
+import { V2VariantChooser } from "./VariantChooser";
+import { variantModel } from "./variantModel";
+import { v2Gallery, v2Price } from "./viewModel";
+
+export function V2ProductCard({ entry, priority = false, filters }: {
+  entry: CatalogProduct; priority?: boolean;
+  filters?: Pick<CatalogFilters, "color" | "size" | "sizeLabel">;
+}) {
+  const { pick, lang, money, t } = useI18n();
+  const { variantsOf, catalogContext, settings, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets, mode } = useStorefront();
+  const { add } = useStoreCart();
+  const { inWishlist, toggleWishlist } = useStoreAccount();
+  const { product, content } = entry;
+  const name = pick(product.name_ar, product.name_en);
+  const route = `/store/products/${encodeURIComponent(content?.slug?.trim() || product.id)}`;
+  const allVariants = variantsOf(product.id);
+  const model = useMemo(() => variantModel(allVariants, catalogContext.reservedVariant, product.stock_tracking_enabled),
+    [allVariants, catalogContext.reservedVariant, product.stock_tracking_enabled]);
+  const narrowed = Boolean(filters && (filters.color || filters.size !== null || filters.sizeLabel));
+  const shownVariants = narrowed && filters
+    ? allVariants.filter((variant) => variantMatchesCatalogFilters(variant, filters)) : allVariants;
+  const pricing = v2Price(product, shownVariants, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets,
+    null, catalogContext.reservedVariant);
+  const gallery = v2Gallery(product, content);
+  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
+  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<StoreVariant | null>(null);
+  const [colorKey, setColorKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
+  const wished = inWishlist(product.id);
+  const matchingSellable = narrowed && filters
+    ? model.sellable.filter((variant) => variantMatchesCatalogFilters(variant, filters)) : model.sellable;
+  const sellable = product.stock_tracking_enabled && (product.variants_enabled
+    ? matchingSellable.length > 0
+    : entry.available !== null && entry.available > 0);
+
+  const badges = entry.badges.filter((badge) => badge === "new" ? settings.badges.show_new
+    : badge === "sale" ? settings.badges.show_sale
+      : badge === "bestSeller" ? settings.badges.show_best_seller
+        : badge === "featured");
+  const badge = badges[0] ?? (settings.badges.show_sale && pricing.price < pricing.list ? "sale" : null);
+  const campaignBadge = campaignBadgeText(product.id, campaigns, pick);
+  const limited = settings.badges.show_limited && product.stock_tracking_enabled &&
+    entry.available !== null && entry.available > 0 && entry.available <= product.low_stock_level;
+  const colorPreview = model.groups.find((group) => group.color_key === colorKey)
+    ?.variants.find((variant) => variant.image_url)?.image_url;
+
+  function addVariant(variant: StoreVariant | null) {
+    if (add(product, 1, variant)) {
+      setOpen(false);
+      setNotice(t("store.v2.added"));
+    } else {
+      setNotice(t("store.error.insufficient_stock"));
+    }
+  }
+  function quickAdd() {
+    setNotice("");
+    if (!sellable) return;
+    if (!product.variants_enabled) {
+      addVariant(null);
+    } else if (narrowed && matchingSellable.length === 1) {
+      addVariant(matchingSellable[0]);
+    } else if (!narrowed && model.soleQuickAdd()) {
+      addVariant(model.soleQuickAdd());
+    } else {
+      setOpen((value) => !value);
+      setChosen(null);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const cardAvailable = narrowed ? entry.available : product.variants_enabled
+    ? model.sellable.reduce((sum, variant) => sum + model.remaining(variant), 0)
+    : entry.available;
+
+  return (
+    <article className="v2-product-card" data-testid={`v2-card-${product.id}`}
+      data-align={settings.product_card.text_align}>
+      <div className="v2-product-media" data-aspect={settings.product_card.aspect}>
+        <Link to={route} className="v2-product-photo" aria-label={name}>
+          <V2Image src={colorPreview || gallery[0]} alt={name} priority={priority} fit={settings.product_card.image_fit} />
+          {gallery[1] ? <V2Image src={gallery[1]} alt="" className="v2-photo-alt" fit={settings.product_card.image_fit} /> : null}
+        </Link>
+        {settings.product_card.show_badge && (badge || limited) ? (
+          <span className="v2-product-badge">{badge
+            ? badge === "sale" && campaignBadge ? campaignBadge : t(`store.badge.${badge}`)
+            : t("store.v2.limited")}</span>
+        ) : null}
+        {settings.product_card.show_wishlist ? (
+          <button type="button" className="v2-wishlist" data-testid="v2-wishlist" aria-pressed={wished}
+            aria-label={t(wished ? "store.wishlist.remove" : "store.wishlist.add")}
+            onClick={() => void toggleWishlist(product.id)}>
+            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden><path d="M12 20 4.5 12.7A4.6 4.6 0 0 1 11 6.2l1 1 1-1a4.6 4.6 0 0 1 6.5 6.5L12 20Z" fill={wished ? "currentColor" : "none"} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" /></svg>
+          </button>
+        ) : null}
+      </div>
+      <div className="v2-card-meta">
+        {entry.brand ? <p className="v2-card-brand">{content ? pick(content.brand_ar, content.brand_en) : entry.brand}</p> : null}
+        <Link className="v2-card-name" to={route}>{name}</Link>
+        {settings.product_card.show_price ? <div className="v2-card-price">
+          {pricing.from ? <span className="v2-price-from">{t("store.variants.from")} </span> : null}
+          <strong>{money(pricing.price)}</strong>
+          {pricing.price < pricing.list ? <del>{money(pricing.list)}</del> : null}
+        </div> : null}
+        {settings.product_card.show_swatches && model.hasColors ? (
+          <div className="v2-card-swatches" role="group" aria-label={t("store.variants.color")}>
+            {model.groups.slice(0, 6).map((group) => {
+              const available = group.variants.some((variant) => model.remaining(variant) > 0);
+              const label = variantColorLabel(group, lang) || t("store.variants.defaultColor");
+              return <button type="button" key={group.color_key} disabled={!available}
+                aria-label={`${t("store.variants.color")}: ${label}${available ? "" : ` — ${t("store.variants.soldOut")}`}`}
+                aria-pressed={colorKey === group.color_key}
+                onClick={() => { setColorKey(group.color_key); setChosen(null); }}>
+                <span className="v2-swatch" style={{ backgroundColor: group.color_hex || "transparent" }} aria-hidden />
+              </button>;
+            })}
+          </div>
+        ) : null}
+        <V2Status available={cardAvailable} mode={mode} tracked={product.stock_tracking_enabled} />
+        {settings.product_card.show_quick_add ? (
+          <button type="button" className="v2-card-add" data-testid={`v2-quick-add-${product.id}`}
+            disabled={!sellable} aria-expanded={product.variants_enabled && matchingSellable.length > 1 ? open : undefined}
+            onClick={quickAdd}>
+            <span>{!sellable ? t("store.product.unavailable") : product.variants_enabled && matchingSellable.length > 1
+              ? t("store.v2.selectOptions") : t("store.v2.quickAdd")}</span>
+            <span aria-hidden>{open ? "−" : "+"}</span>
+          </button>
+        ) : null}
+        {open && model.variants.length > 1 ? (
+          <div className="v2-card-options" data-testid="v2-card-options">
+            <V2VariantChooser model={model} colorKey={colorKey} variantId={chosen?.id ?? null} compact
+              onChoice={(variant, key) => { setChosen(variant); setColorKey(key); }} />
+            <button type="button" className="v2-solid-button" disabled={!chosen} onClick={() => addVariant(chosen)}>
+              {t("store.product.addToCart")}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        ) : null}
+        <span className="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">{notice}</span>
+      </div>
+    </article>
+  );
+}

+/** One safe channel resolver and one icon row for the public V2 footer and the
+ * inert Admin draft sample. Content is shared WebsiteSettings, never V2-only. */
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { dictionaries, type Language } from "@/lib/i18n/dictionary";
+import type { SocialPlatform, WebsiteSettings } from "../types";
+import { resolvedSocialLinks } from "../services/settingsDefaults";
+import { socialChannelHref } from "../services/socialSafety";
+import { SocialIcon } from "../components/storefront/SocialIcon";
+
+export type V2SocialChannel = { platform: SocialPlatform; href: string; label: string };
+const ORDER: SocialPlatform[] = ["facebook", "instagram", "tiktok", "whatsapp"];
+
+/** Always use the shared resolver so a legacy URL, an explicitly disabled row,
+ * and an owner-edited bilingual WhatsApp message behave identically in preview
+ * and on a fresh public route. Malformed stored rows fail closed. */
+export function resolvedV2SocialChannels(settings: WebsiteSettings, language: Language): V2SocialChannel[] {
+  const rows = new Map(resolvedSocialLinks(settings).map((row) => [row.platform, row]));
+  return ORDER.flatMap((platform) => {
+    const row = rows.get(platform);
+    if (!row?.enabled) return [];
+    const message = platform === "whatsapp"
+      ? (language === "ar" ? row.message_ar || row.message_en : row.message_en || row.message_ar) ?? "" : "";
+    const href = socialChannelHref(platform, row.url, message);
+    if (!href) return [];
+    const name = dictionaries[language][`online.settings.${platform}`];
+    const custom = (language === "ar" ? row.label_ar || row.label_en : row.label_en || row.label_ar).trim();
+    const label = custom && custom.toLowerCase() !== name.toLowerCase() ? `${name} — ${custom}` : name;
+    return [{ platform, href, label }];
+  });
+}
+
+export function V2SocialIcons({ channels, inert = false }: { channels: V2SocialChannel[]; inert?: boolean }) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  if (!channels.length) return null;
+  return <div className="v2-footer-social" role="group" aria-label={t("store.social.followUs")}
+    data-testid="v2-social-icons">
+    {channels.map((channel) => inert
+      ? <span key={channel.platform} className="v2-social-icon" data-platform={channel.platform}>
+          <SocialIcon kind={channel.platform} />
+        </span>
+      : <a key={channel.platform} className="v2-social-icon" data-platform={channel.platform}
+          href={channel.href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
+          title={channel.label} aria-label={`${channel.label} ${t("common.opensInNewTab")}`}>
+          <SocialIcon kind={channel.platform} />
+        </a>)}
+  </div>;
+}

+/** V2 About: one editorial source in WebsiteSettings.about, not hard-coded
+ * company facts. Missing optional content gets a modest, localized fallback. */
+import { useEffect } from "react";
+import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { absoluteUrl, applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta, keywordList } from "../services/seo";
+import { V2ActionLink, V2Image } from "./Primitives";
+
+export function StorefrontV2About() {
+  const { t, pick, lang } = useI18n();
+  const { settings } = useStorefront();
+  const about = settings.about;
+  const title = pick(about.title_ar, about.title_en).trim() || t("store.nav.about");
+  const body = pick(about.body_ar, about.body_en).trim();
+  const storeName = pick(settings.contact.store_name_ar, settings.contact.store_name_en) || "ALYQ";
+  const cta = pick(about.cta_ar, about.cta_en).trim();
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: `${title} — ${storeName}`,
+      description: body.slice(0, 160) || pick(settings.contact.tagline_ar, settings.contact.tagline_en),
+      canonical: absoluteUrl(window.location.href.split("#")[0], "#/store/about"),
+      keywords: keywordList(settings.seo.keywords), ogImage: about.image_url,
+      locale: lang === "ar" ? "ar_EG" : "en_US", siteName: storeName });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [about.image_url, body, lang, pick, settings.contact.tagline_ar, settings.contact.tagline_en,
+    settings.seo.keywords, storeName, title]);
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container v2-about" data-testid="v2-about">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+    <div className="v2-about-layout">{about.image_url ? <div className="v2-about-photo">
+      <V2Image src={about.image_url} alt={title} priority /></div> : null}
+      <div className="v2-about-copy"><h1>{title}</h1>
+        {body ? body.split(/\n{2,}/).map((paragraph, index) => <p key={index} className="v2-preline">{paragraph.trim()}</p>)
+          : <p>{pick(settings.contact.tagline_ar, settings.contact.tagline_en)}</p>}
+        {cta && about.cta_href ? <V2ActionLink href={about.cta_href} className="v2-primary-button">{cta} ↗</V2ActionLink> : null}
+        <Link to="/store/products" className="v2-text-link">{t("store.cart.continueShopping")} ↗</Link>
+      </div></div>
+  </div>;

+/** Browser-local shopper profile, using the same StoreAccountProvider as legacy.
+ * Order history is fetched by the existing per-reference + phone lookup;
+ * reorder is checked by exact variant UUID before touching the shared cart. */
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
+import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStoreAccount } from "../hooks/StoreAccountProvider";
+import { storeLineKey, useStoreCart } from "../hooks/StoreCartProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { findCatalogProduct, searchCatalog, EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS } from "../services/catalogQuery";
+import { applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta } from "../services/seo";
+import type { CustomerAddress, OnlineOrder } from "../types";
+import { planV2Reorder, type V2ReorderPlan } from "./journeyModel";
+import { V2Panel } from "./JourneyParts";
+import { V2ProductCard } from "./ProductCard";
+import { V2ProductGrid } from "./Primitives";
+
+type Tab = "profile" | "addresses" | "wishlist" | "orders";
+const tabs: Tab[] = ["profile", "addresses", "wishlist", "orders"];
+function tabFrom(raw: string | null): Tab { return tabs.find((item) => item === raw) ?? "profile"; }
+const newAddress = (): CustomerAddress => ({ id: "", label: "", full_name: "", phone: "",
+  city: "", area: "", street: "", building: "", floor: "", apartment: "", notes: "", is_default: false });
+const addressFields = ["label", "full_name", "phone", "city", "area", "street", "building", "floor", "apartment"] as const;
+
+export function StorefrontV2Account() {
+  const { t, pick, money, lang } = useI18n();
+  const navigate = useNavigate();
+  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
+  const { products, contents, variants, catalogContext, loading: catalogueLoading,
+    error: catalogueError, refresh: refreshCatalog } = useStorefront();
+  const { addMany, lines } = useStoreCart();
+  const account = useStoreAccount();
+  const { customer, loading, busy, error, clearError, register, login, logout, updateProfile,
+    addresses, addAddress, updateAddress, removeAddress, setDefaultAddress, wishlist,
+    history, historyLoading, refreshHistory } = account;
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"login" | "register">("login");
+  const tab = tabFrom(params.get("tab"));
+  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState("");
+  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
+  const [regName, setRegName] = useState("");
+  const [regPhone, setRegPhone] = useState("");
+  const [regEmail, setRegEmail] = useState("");
+  const [regPassword, setRegPassword] = useState("");
+  const [profileName, setProfileName] = useState(customer?.name ?? "");
+  const [profilePhone, setProfilePhone] = useState(customer?.phone ?? "");
+  const [profileEmail, setProfileEmail] = useState(customer?.email ?? "");
+  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
+  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<CustomerAddress | null>(null);
+  const [reorderProblem, setReorderProblem] = useState("");
+  const [reorderSuccess, setReorderSuccess] = useState("");
+  const [pendingReorder, setPendingReorder] = useState<{
+    order: OnlineOrder;
+    ready: V2ReorderPlan["ready"];
+    unavailable: string[];
+    before: Map<string, number>;
+  } | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: t("store.account.title"), description: "", noIndex: true });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [t]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (customer) { setProfileName(customer.name); setProfilePhone(customer.phone); setProfileEmail(customer.email ?? ""); }
+  }, [customer]);
+  // The account provider is mounted across sibling V2 routes. A newly placed
+  // order can therefore arrive after its initial history effect: revisit the
+  // same private reference+phone lookups whenever the shopper opens Orders.
+  useEffect(() => { if (customer && tab === "orders") void refreshHistory(); }, [customer, tab, refreshHistory]);
+  const wishlistEntries = useMemo(() => wishlist.flatMap((id) => {
+    const product = findCatalogProduct(id, products, contents);
+    if (!product) return [];
+    return searchCatalog([product], { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, productIds: [product.id] }, catalogContext);
+  }), [wishlist, products, contents, catalogContext]);
+
+  const saveProfile = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault(); setSaved(false);
+    void updateProfile({ name: profileName.trim(), phone: profilePhone.trim(),
+      email: profileEmail.trim() || null }).then(setSaved);
+  };
+  const saveAddress = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    if (!draft || !draft.city.trim() || !draft.area.trim() || !draft.street.trim()) return;
+    const value = { ...draft, id: draft.id || `addr_${Date.now().toString(36)}` };
+    void (draft.id ? updateAddress(value) : addAddress(value)).then((ok) => { if (ok) setDraft(null); });
+  };
+  // Include both the historical item name and SKU, never an inferred new
+  // colour/size. A repeated SKU is only reported once in the warning.
+  const reorderLabels = useCallback((order: OnlineOrder, skus: string[]) =>
+    [...new Set(skus)].map((sku) => {
+      const item = order.items.find((row) => row.sku === sku);
+      const name = item ? pick(item.name_ar, item.name_en).trim() : "";
+      return name ? `${name} (${sku})` : sku;
+    }).join(", "), [pick]);
+
+  // addMany's immediate count is not reliable under React's deferred state
+  // updaters: it can return 0 even when it actually adds a line. Observe the
+  // committed shared-cart lines before claiming success or refusing a shelf.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!pendingReorder) return;
+    const after = new Map<string, number>();
+    for (const line of lines) {
+      const key = storeLineKey(line.product_id, line.variant_id);
+      after.set(key, (after.get(key) ?? 0) + line.quantity);
+    }
+    const cartChanged = pendingReorder.ready.some((line) => {
+      const key = storeLineKey(line.product_id, line.variant_id);
+      return (after.get(key) ?? 0) > (pendingReorder.before.get(key) ?? 0);
+    });
+    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      const expected = new Map(pendingReorder.before);
+      const unavailable = [...pendingReorder.unavailable];
+      let added = 0;
+      for (const line of pendingReorder.ready) {
+        const key = storeLineKey(line.product_id, line.variant_id);
+        const target = (expected.get(key) ?? 0) + line.quantity;
+        expected.set(key, target);
+        if ((after.get(key) ?? 0) >= target) added++;
+        else unavailable.push(pendingReorder.order.items.find((item) => item.product_id === line.product_id &&
+          (item.variant_id ?? null) === line.variant_id)?.sku ?? line.product_id);
+      }
+      if (unavailable.length) setReorderProblem(reorderLabels(pendingReorder.order, unavailable));
+      if (added) setReorderSuccess(pendingReorder.order.order_number);
+      setPendingReorder(null);
+      // All-valid keeps the original navigation; partial reorder stays here
+      // with its specific warning and explicit V2 bag link.
+      if (added && !unavailable.length) navigate("/store/cart");
+    // A deferred updater may not have committed yet at the first effect. Wait
+    // for the cart change; if every line is refused, eventually show the error.
+    }, cartChanged ? 50 : 750);
+    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
+  }, [lines, navigate, pendingReorder, reorderLabels]);
+
+  const reorder = (order: OnlineOrder) => {
+    if (pendingReorder || catalogueLoading || catalogueError) return;
+    setReorderProblem(""); setReorderSuccess("");
+    const plan = planV2Reorder(order, products, variants, catalogContext.reserved,
+      catalogContext.reservedVariant, lines);
+    if (!plan.ready.length) {
+      setReorderProblem(reorderLabels(order, plan.unavailable) || t("store.v2.journey.reorderUnavailable"));
+      return;
+    }
+    const before = new Map<string, number>();
+    for (const line of lines) {
+      const key = storeLineKey(line.product_id, line.variant_id);
+      before.set(key, (before.get(key) ?? 0) + line.quantity);
+    }
+    addMany(plan.ready); // the shared cart independently rechecks each exact line
+    setPendingReorder({ order, ready: plan.ready, unavailable: plan.unavailable, before });
+  };
+
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container" data-testid="v2-account">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+    <div className="v2-journey-title"><h1>{customer ? t("store.account.hello", { name: customer.name }) : t("store.account.title")}</h1>
+      {customer ? <button type="button" className="v2-outline-button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void logout()}>
+        {t("store.account.signOut")}</button> : null}</div>
+    <p className="v2-small">{t("store.v2.journey.browserLocal")}</p>
+    {error ? <p role="alert" className="v2-alert">{t(`store.error.${error}` as never)}
+      <button type="button" onClick={clearError}>{t("common.dismiss")}</button></p> : null}
+    {loading ? <p role="status" className="v2-small">{t("common.loading")}</p> : !customer ?
+      <div className="v2-account-auth"><div className="v2-account-tabs" role="group" aria-label={t("store.account.title")}>
+        <button type="button" aria-pressed={mode === "login"} onClick={() => setMode("login")}>{t("store.account.signIn")}</button>
+        <button type="button" aria-pressed={mode === "register"} onClick={() => setMode("register")}>{t("store.account.register")}</button>
+      </div><V2Panel>
+        {mode === "login" ? <form className="v2-account-form" onSubmit={(event) => {
+          event.preventDefault(); void login({ identifier, password });
+        }}>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.account.identifier")}
+            <input autoComplete="username" value={identifier} onChange={(event) => setIdentifier(event.target.value)}
+              placeholder={t("store.account.identifierPlaceholder")} required /></label>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.account.password")}
+            <input type="password" autoComplete="current-password" value={password}
+              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)} required /></label>
+          <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !identifier.trim() || !password} className="v2-primary-button">
+            {busy ? t("common.loading") : t("store.account.signIn")}</button>
+          <p className="v2-small">{t("store.account.guestCheckoutNote")}{" "}
+            <Link to="/store/track">{t("store.track.title")}</Link></p>
+        </form> : <form className="v2-account-form" onSubmit={(event) => {
+          event.preventDefault(); void register({ name: regName.trim(), phone: regPhone.trim(),
+            email: regEmail.trim() || null, password: regPassword });
+        }}>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.checkout.fullName")}
+            <input value={regName} onChange={(event) => setRegName(event.target.value)} autoComplete="name" required /></label>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.checkout.phone")}
+            <input dir="ltr" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" value={regPhone} onChange={(event) => setRegPhone(event.target.value)} required /></label>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.checkout.email")} ({t("common.optional")})
+            <input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={regEmail} onChange={(event) => setRegEmail(event.target.value)} /></label>
+          <label className="v2-field">{t("store.account.password")}
+            <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={regPassword}
+              onChange={(event) => setRegPassword(event.target.value)} minLength={6} required /></label>
+          <p className="v2-small">{t("store.account.passwordRule")}</p>
+          <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !regName.trim() || !regPhone.trim() || regPassword.length < 6}
+            className="v2-primary-button">{busy ? t("common.loading") : t("store.account.createAccount")}</button>
+        </form>}
+      </V2Panel></div> : <div className="v2-account-grid">
+        <nav className="v2-account-nav" aria-label={t("store.account.title")}>
+          {tabs.map((item) => <button key={item} type="button" aria-current={tab === item ? "page" : undefined}
+            onClick={() => setParams({ tab: item }, { replace: true })}>

+            {item === "wishlist" && wishlist.length ? ` (${wishlist.length})` : ""}
+            {item === "orders" && history.length ? ` (${history.length})` : ""}</button>)}

+/** V2 cart presentation over the existing StoreCartProvider. No separate line
+ * identity, price, coupon, stock or checkout implementation. */
+import { useEffect } from "react";
+import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStoreCart, storeLineKey } from "../hooks/StoreCartProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta } from "../services/seo";
+import { V2Image, V2Status } from "./Primitives";
+import { V2CartTotals, V2Coupon, V2Panel } from "./JourneyParts";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Cart() {
+  const { t, pick, money } = useI18n();
+  const { settings, mode, loading, error, refresh } = useStorefront();
+  const { entries, lines, unitCount, isEmpty, increase, decrease, remove, clear,
+    totals, problems, prunedCount, acknowledgePruned } = useStoreCart();
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: t("store.cart.title"), description: "", noIndex: true });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [t]);
+  const unlisted = Math.max(0, lines.length - entries.length);
+  const blocked = problems.length > 0 || unlisted > 0 || entries.some((entry) => !entry.product.stock_tracking_enabled);
+  const canCheckout = !blocked && (settings.delivery.enabled || settings.delivery.pickup_enabled) &&
+    (settings.delivery.cod_enabled || settings.delivery.instapay_enabled);
+
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container" data-testid="v2-cart">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+    <h1>{t("store.cart.title")}</h1>
+    {prunedCount > 0 ? <p role="status" className="v2-alert" data-testid="v2-cart-pruned">
+      {t("store.v2.journey.cartPruned")}
+      <button type="button" onClick={acknowledgePruned}>{t("common.dismiss")}</button></p> : null}
+    {loading && !entries.length ? <p className="v2-small" role="status">{t("common.loading")}</p> : null}
+    {error && !entries.length ? <V2Panel><p role="alert">{t("store.v2.error")}</p>
+      <button type="button" className="v2-outline-button" onClick={() => void refresh()}>{t("store.v2.retry")}</button></V2Panel> : null}
+    {!loading && !error && isEmpty ? <V2Panel className="v2-journey-empty">
+      <p>{t("store.cart.emptyHint")}</p>
+      <Link to="/store/products" className="v2-primary-button">{t("store.cart.startShopping")}</Link>
+    </V2Panel> : null}
+    {!isEmpty ? <>
+      <p className="v2-small">{t("store.cart.itemCount", { count: unitCount })}</p>
+      {blocked ? <p role="alert" className="v2-alert">{t("store.cart.stockProblem")}</p> : null}
+      <div className="v2-journey-grid">
+        <div className="v2-cart-lines" aria-label={t("store.cart.title")}>
+          {entries.map((entry) => {
+            const variantId = entry.variant?.id ?? null;
+            const key = storeLineKey(entry.product.id, variantId);
+            const issue = problems.find((problem) => storeLineKey(problem.product_id, problem.variant_id) === key);
+            const path = `/store/products/${encodeURIComponent(entry.content?.slug?.trim() || entry.product.id)}`;
+            const name = pick(entry.product.name_ar, entry.product.name_en);
+            return <article className="v2-cart-line" key={key} data-testid="v2-cart-line" data-variant-id={variantId ?? ""}>
+              <Link to={path} className="v2-cart-photo" aria-label={name}>
+                <V2Image src={entry.variant?.image_url || entry.product.image_url || entry.product.images[0]}
+                  alt={name} fit="contain" />
+              </Link>
+              <div className="v2-cart-line-body"><div className="v2-cart-line-head">
+                <Link to={path} className="v2-cart-line-name">{name}</Link>
+                <button type="button" className="v2-cart-remove" aria-label={`${t("store.cart.remove")}: ${name}`}
+                  onClick={() => remove(entry.product.id, variantId)}>{t("store.cart.remove")}</button>
+              </div>
+                {entry.variantLabel ? <p className="v2-cart-variant" data-testid="v2-cart-variant">
+                  {entry.variantLabel} · {entry.variant?.sku}</p> : <p className="v2-small">{entry.product.sku}</p>}
+                <V2Status available={entry.available} mode={mode} tracked={entry.product.stock_tracking_enabled} />
+                {issue ? <p className="v2-field-error" role="alert">{t("store.cart.onlyAvailable", { count: issue.available })}</p> : null}
+                <div className="v2-cart-line-bottom"><div className="v2-stepper" role="group" aria-label={`${t("store.v2.quantity")}: ${name}`}>
+                  <button type="button" onClick={() => decrease(entry.product.id, variantId)} aria-label={t("store.cart.decrease")}>−</button>
+                  <output aria-label={t("store.v2.quantity")}>{entry.quantity}</output>
+                  <button type="button" onClick={() => increase(entry.product.id, variantId)}
+                    disabled={entry.available !== null && entry.quantity >= entry.available}
+                    aria-label={t("store.cart.increase")}>+</button>
+                </div><div className="v2-cart-line-price"><span>{money(entry.price)} × {entry.quantity}</span>
+                  <strong>{money(entry.lineTotal)}</strong>
+                  {entry.price < entry.listPrice ? <del>{money(entry.listPrice * entry.quantity)}</del> : null}
+                </div></div>
+              </div>
+            </article>;
+          })}
+          <div className="v2-cart-actions"><Link to="/store/products" className="v2-text-link">
+            {t("store.cart.continueShopping")} ↗</Link>
+            <button type="button" onClick={clear}>{t("store.cart.clear")}</button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+        <aside className="v2-journey-aside"><V2Panel title={t("store.cart.summary")}>
+          <V2CartTotals showDelivery />
+          <V2Coupon />
+          {!canCheckout ? <p className="v2-field-error" role="status">{blocked ? t("store.cart.stockProblem")
+            : t("store.checkout.orderingDisabled")}</p> : null}
+          <Link to="/store/checkout" aria-disabled={!canCheckout} tabIndex={canCheckout ? 0 : -1}
+            onClick={(event) => { if (!canCheckout) event.preventDefault(); }}
+            className="v2-primary-button v2-cart-checkout" data-testid="v2-cart-checkout">
+            {t("store.cart.checkout")} ↗</Link>
+          <p className="v2-small">{t("store.v2.stockAtCheckout")}</p>
+        </V2Panel></aside>
+      </div>
+    </> : null}
+    {/* Advisory totals are explicitly not the amount the RPC will accept. */}
+    <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">{!isEmpty && totals.unit_count}</span>
+  </div>;
+}

+/** URL-backed V2 search, sorting and catalogue facets. All options come from
+ * the published shared catalogue; the mobile sheet has an escape route and
+ * focus containment without a separate search/stock/pricing system. */
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
+import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import {
+  EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, filtersFromSearchParams, filtersToSearchParams, STOREFRONT_SORTS,
+  type CatalogFilters,
+} from "../services/catalogQuery";
+import { absoluteUrl, applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta } from "../services/seo";
+import { v2CatalogResults } from "./viewModel";
+import { V2ProductCard } from "./ProductCard";
+import { V2ProductGrid, V2State } from "./Primitives";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Catalog() {
+  const { t, pick, money } = useI18n();
+  const { products, categoriesFacet, categoryContents, brandsFacet, catalogContext, priceRange,
+    campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets, loading, error, refresh, settings } = useStorefront();
+  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
+  const filters = useMemo(() => filtersFromSearchParams(params), [params]);
+  const [search, setSearch] = useState(filters.search);
+  const [minPrice, setMinPrice] = useState(filters.minPrice?.toString() ?? "");
+  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState(filters.maxPrice?.toString() ?? "");
+  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
+  const filterButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const filterDrawer = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const contentByCategory = new Map(categoryContents.map((content) => [content.category_id, content]));
+  const offered = params.get("offer") === "1";
+  const category = categoriesFacet.find((item) => item.id === filters.categoryId);
+  const heading = category ? pick(contentByCategory.get(category.id)?.title_ar || category.name_ar,
+    contentByCategory.get(category.id)?.title_en || category.name_en) : t("store.v2.collection");
+
+  // Catalog options use published, active products/combinations only. No guessed
+  // colour or letter-size menu; changing the admin catalogue updates the facets.
+  const variants = useMemo(() => products.filter((item) => item.active && item.show_on_website)
+    .flatMap((item) => catalogContext.variants?.get(item.id) ?? []).filter((variant) => variant.active),
+  [products, catalogContext.variants]);
+  const colors = useMemo(() => [...new Map(variants.filter((variant) => variant.color_key)
+    .map((variant) => [variant.color_key, variant] as const)).entries()]
+    .map(([key, variant]) => ({ key, label: pick(variant.color_ar, variant.color_en) || key }))
+    .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label)), [variants, pick]);
+  const sizes = useMemo(() => {
+    const values = new Map<string, { value: string; label: string; sort: number }>();
+    variants.forEach((variant) => {
+      if (variant.size !== null) values.set(`n:${variant.size}`, {
+        value: `n:${variant.size}`, label: String(variant.size), sort: variant.size });
+      else if (variant.size_label?.trim()) values.set(`l:${variant.size_label.trim()}`, {
+        value: `l:${variant.size_label.trim()}`, label: variant.size_label.trim(), sort: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY });
+    });
+    return [...values.values()].sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
+  }, [variants]);
+  const sizeValue = filters.size !== null ? `n:${filters.size}` : filters.sizeLabel ? `l:${filters.sizeLabel}` : "";
+  const activeCount = [Boolean(filters.search), filters.categoryId !== "all", Boolean(filters.brand),
+    Boolean(filters.color), Boolean(sizeValue), filters.minPrice !== null, filters.maxPrice !== null,
+    filters.availability !== "any", offered].filter(Boolean).length;
+
+  useEffect(() => { setSearch(filters.search); }, [filters.search]);
+  useEffect(() => { setMinPrice(filters.minPrice?.toString() ?? ""); setMaxPrice(filters.maxPrice?.toString() ?? ""); },
+    [filters.minPrice, filters.maxPrice]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: `${heading} — ${pick(settings.contact.store_name_ar, settings.contact.store_name_en)}`,
+      description: settings.seo.meta_description,
+      canonical: absoluteUrl(window.location.href.split("#")[0], "#/store/products") });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [heading, pick, settings.contact.store_name_ar, settings.contact.store_name_en, settings.seo.meta_description]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!filtersOpen || !window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)").matches) return;
+    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;
+    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
+    filterDrawer.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".v2-filter-close")?.focus();
+    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); setFiltersOpen(false); filterButton.current?.focus(); return; }
+      if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
+      const focusable = [...(filterDrawer.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),select:not(:disabled)") ?? [])]
+        .filter((item) => item.getClientRects().length > 0);
+      if (!focusable.length) return;
+      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[0]) {
+        event.preventDefault(); focusable.at(-1)?.focus();
+      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable.at(-1)) {
+        event.preventDefault(); focusable[0].focus();
+      }
+    };
+    const onResize = () => { if (!window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)").matches) setFiltersOpen(false); };
+    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
+    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
+    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = previous; window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
+      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize); };
+  }, [filtersOpen]);
+
+  const results = useMemo(() => v2CatalogResults(products, filters, catalogContext,
+    campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets, offered),
+  [products, filters, catalogContext, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets, offered]);
+  const apply = (patch: Partial<CatalogFilters>, offer = offered) => {
+    const next = filtersToSearchParams({ ...filters, ...patch });
+    if (offer) next.set("offer", "1");
+    setParams(next);
+  };
+  const submitSearch = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => { event.preventDefault(); apply({ search: search.trim() }); };
+  const applyPrice = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const number = (raw: string) => raw.trim() && Number.isFinite(Number(raw)) ? Math.max(0, Number(raw)) : null;
+    apply({ minPrice: number(minPrice), maxPrice: number(maxPrice) });
+  };
+  const clear = () => { setSearch(""); setMinPrice(""); setMaxPrice("");
+    setParams(filtersToSearchParams(EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS)); setFiltersOpen(false); };
+
+  return <div className="v2-catalog v2-container" data-testid="v2-catalog">
+    <div className="v2-catalog-intro"><p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+      <h1>{heading}</h1><p>{t("store.v2.results", { count: results.length })}</p></div>
+    <form className="v2-catalog-search" onSubmit={submitSearch} role="search">
+      <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="v2-search-input">{t("store.search.label")}</label>
+      <input id="v2-search-input" type="search" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
+        placeholder={t("store.search.placeholder")} />
+      <button type="submit">{t("store.v2.searchGo")} ↗</button>
+    </form>
+    <div className="v2-category-chips" role="group" aria-label={t("store.nav.categories")}>
+      <button type="button" aria-pressed={filters.categoryId === "all"} onClick={() => apply({ categoryId: "all" })}>{t("store.v2.allCategories")}</button>
+      {categoriesFacet.map((item) => <button type="button" key={item.id} aria-pressed={filters.categoryId === item.id}
+        onClick={() => apply({ categoryId: item.id })}>
+        {pick(contentByCategory.get(item.id)?.title_ar || item.name_ar, contentByCategory.get(item.id)?.title_en || item.name_en)}
+      </button>)}
+    </div>
+    <div className="v2-filter-bar">
+      <button type="button" className="v2-filter-toggle" aria-expanded={filtersOpen} aria-controls="v2-filters"
+        ref={filterButton} onClick={() => setFiltersOpen((value) => !value)}>
+        {t("store.v2.activeFilters")}{activeCount ? ` (${activeCount})` : ""} <span aria-hidden>☷</span></button>
+      {filtersOpen ? <button type="button" className="v2-filter-backdrop" aria-label={t("common.close")}
+        onClick={() => { setFiltersOpen(false); filterButton.current?.focus(); }} /> : null}
+      <div className="v2-filter-controls" id="v2-filters" data-open={filtersOpen}
+        ref={filterDrawer} role={filtersOpen && window.innerWidth < 768 ? "dialog" : undefined}
+        aria-modal={filtersOpen && window.innerWidth < 768 ? true : undefined}
+        aria-label={filtersOpen && window.innerWidth < 768 ? t("store.filters.title") : undefined}>
+        <div className="v2-filter-drawer-top"><strong>{t("store.filters.title")}</strong>
+          <button type="button" className="v2-filter-close" onClick={() => {
+            setFiltersOpen(false); filterButton.current?.focus(); }} aria-label={t("common.close")}>×</button></div>
+        <label>{t("store.sort.label")}
+          <select value={filters.sort} onChange={(event) => apply({ sort: event.target.value as CatalogFilters["sort"] })}>
+            {STOREFRONT_SORTS.map((key) => <option key={key} value={key}>{t(`store.sort.${key === "price_asc" ? "priceAsc" : key === "price_desc" ? "priceDesc" : key === "best_selling" ? "bestSelling" : key}`)}</option>)}
+          </select>
+        </label>
+        <label>{t("store.filters.availability")}
+          <select value={filters.availability} onChange={(event) => apply({ availability: event.target.value as CatalogFilters["availability"] })}>
+            {(["any", "in_stock", "out_of_stock"] as const).map((key) =>
+              <option key={key} value={key}>{t(`store.filters.availability.${key}`)}</option>)}</select>
+        </label>
+        {brandsFacet.length ? <label>{t("store.filters.brand")}
+          <select value={filters.brand ?? ""} onChange={(event) => apply({ brand: event.target.value || null })}>
+            <option value="">{t("common.all")}</option>
+            {brandsFacet.map((brand) => <option key={brand.key} value={brand.key}>{brand.label}</option>)}
+          </select>
+        </label> : null}
+        {colors.length ? <label>{t("store.filters.color")}
+          <select value={filters.color ?? ""} onChange={(event) => apply({ color: event.target.value || null })}>
+            <option value="">{t("common.all")}</option>
+            {colors.map((color) => <option key={color.key} value={color.key}>{color.label}</option>)}
+          </select></label> : null}
+        {sizes.length ? <label>{t("store.filters.size")}
+          <select value={sizeValue} onChange={(event) => {
+            const choice = event.target.value;
+            apply({ size: choice.startsWith("n:") ? Number(choice.slice(2)) : null,
+              sizeLabel: choice.startsWith("l:") ? choice.slice(2) : null });
+          }}><option value="">{t("common.all")}</option>
+            {sizes.map((size) => <option key={size.value} value={size.value}>{size.label}</option>)}
+          </select></label> : null}
+        <form className="v2-price-filter" onSubmit={applyPrice}>
+          <label>{t("store.filters.minPrice")}
+            <input type="number" min="0" inputMode="decimal" value={minPrice}
+              placeholder={priceRange ? money(priceRange.min) : undefined}
+              onChange={(event) => setMinPrice(event.target.value)} /></label>
+          <label>{t("store.filters.maxPrice")}
+            <input type="number" min="0" inputMode="decimal" value={maxPrice}
+              placeholder={priceRange ? money(priceRange.max) : undefined}
+              onChange={(event) => setMaxPrice(event.target.value)} /></label>
+          <button type="submit" className="v2-outline-button">{t("store.v2.apply")}</button>
+        </form>
+        <button type="button" aria-pressed={offered} className="v2-offer-filter" onClick={() => apply({}, !offered)}>

+        <button type="button" className="v2-clear-filters" onClick={clear}>{t("store.filters.clear")}</button>
+        <button type="button" className="v2-filter-done v2-primary-button" onClick={() => {
+          setFiltersOpen(false); filterButton.current?.focus(); }}>{t("store.v2.apply")}</button>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+    {activeCount ? <div className="v2-active-filters" role="group" aria-label={t("store.v2.activeFilters")}>
+      {filters.search ? <button type="button" onClick={() => apply({ search: "" })}>{filters.search} ×</button> : null}
+      {filters.color ? <button type="button" onClick={() => apply({ color: null })}>{t("store.filters.color")}: {colors.find((item) => item.key === filters.color)?.label || filters.color} ×</button> : null}
+      {sizeValue ? <button type="button" onClick={() => apply({ size: null, sizeLabel: null })}>{t("store.filters.size")}: {sizeValue.slice(2)} ×</button> : null}
+      {offered ? <button type="button" onClick={() => apply({}, false)}>{t("store.section.onSale")} ×</button> : null}
+      <button type="button" onClick={clear}>{t("store.filters.clear")}</button>
+    </div> : null}
+    {loading && products.length === 0 ? <V2State kind="loading" />
+      : error && products.length === 0 ? <V2State kind="error" onRetry={() => void refresh()} />
+        : results.length ? <V2ProductGrid>{results.map((entry, index) =>
+          <V2ProductCard key={entry.product.id} entry={entry} filters={filters} priority={index < 2} />)}</V2ProductGrid>
+          : <V2State kind="empty" />}
+  </div>;

+/** V2 receipt: render only the order returned by checkout or by the existing
+ * reference+phone lookup. Session storage holds a short-lived *pair*, never
+ * the order body. Another tab/device must use private tracking instead. */
+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStoreCart } from "../hooks/StoreCartProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { resolvedSocialLinks } from "../services/settingsDefaults";
+import { socialChannelHref } from "../services/socialSafety";
+import { applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta } from "../services/seo";
+import type { OnlineOrder } from "../types";
+import { readV2Receipt } from "./journeyModel";
+import { V2ActionLink } from "./Primitives";
+import { V2OrderDetails, V2Panel, V2ProofPanel } from "./JourneyParts";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Confirmation() {
+  const { t, pick } = useI18n();
+  const { settings, lookupOrder } = useStorefront();
+  const { lastOrder, lastWasDuplicate, dismissLastOrder } = useStoreCart();
+  const [restored, setRestored] = useState<OnlineOrder | null>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!lastOrder);
+  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
+  const order = lastOrder ?? restored;
+  const copy = settings.confirmation;
+  const message = pick(copy.message_ar, copy.message_en).trim();
+  const whatsappRow = resolvedSocialLinks(settings).find((row) => row.platform === "whatsapp" && row.enabled);
+  const whatsapp = order && copy.whatsapp_cta && whatsappRow ? socialChannelHref("whatsapp", whatsappRow.url,
+    t("store.confirmation.whatsappMessage", { number: order.order_number })) : null;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: t("store.confirmation.title"), description: "", noIndex: true });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [t]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (lastOrder) { setLoading(false); return; }
+    let pair = null;
+    try { pair = readV2Receipt(window.sessionStorage); } catch { /* private storage */ }
+    if (!pair) { setLoading(false); return; }
+    let active = true;
+    setLoading(true);
+    void lookupOrder(pair.order, pair.phone).then((found) => {
+      if (active) setRestored(found);
+    }).catch(() => { if (active) setRestored(null); }).finally(() => {
+      if (active) setLoading(false);
+    });
+    return () => { active = false; };
+  }, [lastOrder, lookupOrder]);
+
+  const copyNumber = async () => {
+    if (!order) return;
+    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(order.order_number); setCopied(true); }
+    catch { setCopied(false); }
+  };
+
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container" data-testid="v2-confirmation">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.confirmation.received")}</p>
+    <h1>{pick(copy.title_ar, copy.title_en).trim() || t("store.confirmation.title")}</h1>
+    {loading ? <V2Panel><p role="status" className="v2-small">{t("common.loading")}</p></V2Panel> : null}
+    {!loading && !order ? <V2Panel className="v2-journey-empty" testId="v2-receipt-private">
+      <p>{t("store.v2.journey.receiptPrivate")}</p>
+      <Link to="/store/track" className="v2-primary-button">{t("store.confirmation.trackOrder")}</Link>
+    </V2Panel> : null}
+    {order && <>
+      {lastWasDuplicate ? <p className="v2-alert" role="status">{t("store.confirmation.duplicateNote")}</p> : null}
+      <div className="v2-journey-grid"><div className="v2-journey-main">
+        <V2Panel className="v2-receipt-hero">
