+        </V2Panel>
+        <V2ProofPanel order={order} />
+        <V2OrderDetails order={order} />
+      </div><aside className="v2-journey-aside"><V2Panel title={t("store.confirmation.whatHappensNext")}>
+        <ol className="v2-next-steps"><li>{t("store.confirmation.step1")}</li>
+          <li>{t("store.confirmation.step2")}</li><li>{t("store.confirmation.step3")}</li></ol>
+        {order.payment_method === "instapay" ? <p className="v2-alert" role="status">
+          {t("store.checkout.instapayNeverAutomatic")}</p> : <p className="v2-small">{t("store.confirmation.codNote")}</p>}
+        <Link to="/store/track" state={{ number: order.order_number, phone: order.customer_phone }}
+          className="v2-primary-button">{t("store.confirmation.trackOrder")} ↗</Link>
+        {copy.support_href ? <V2ActionLink href={copy.support_href} className="v2-outline-button">
+          {pick(copy.support_cta_ar, copy.support_cta_en) || t("store.nav.contact")}</V2ActionLink> : null}
+        {whatsapp ? <a href={whatsapp} className="v2-text-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
+          {t("store.confirmation.askOnWhatsapp")}</a> : null}
+        <Link to="/store/products" className="v2-text-link" onClick={dismissLastOrder}>
+          {t("store.cart.continueShopping")}</Link>
+      </V2Panel></aside></div>
+    </>}
+  </div>;

+/** V2 Contact: real configured contact data, completed social settings and a
+ * WhatsApp compose link (not a fictional website message inbox). */
+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { externalHref, resolvedSocialLinks } from "../services/settingsDefaults";
+import { socialChannelHref } from "../services/socialSafety";
+import { absoluteUrl, applyDocumentMeta, applyJsonLd, clearDocumentMeta, storeJsonLd } from "../services/seo";
+import { V2Panel } from "./JourneyParts";
+import { resolvedV2SocialChannels } from "./SocialChannels";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Contact() {
+  const { t, pick, lang, money } = useI18n();
+  const { settings, deliveryZones } = useStorefront();
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+  const contact = settings.contact;
+  const address = pick(contact.address_ar, contact.address_en);
+  const hours = pick(contact.hours_ar, contact.hours_en);
+  const name = pick(contact.store_name_ar, contact.store_name_en);
+  const map = externalHref(contact.map_url);
+  const instapay = externalHref(settings.social.instapay_link);
+  const channels = resolvedV2SocialChannels(settings, lang);
+  const whatsapp = resolvedSocialLinks(settings).find((row) => row.platform === "whatsapp" && row.enabled);
+  const send = whatsapp ? socialChannelHref("whatsapp", whatsapp.url,
+    message.trim() || t("store.contact.whatsappMessage")) : null;
+  const phoneHref = contact.phone ? `tel:${contact.phone.replace(/[^+\d]/g, "")}` : null;
+  const emailHref = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(contact.email) ? `mailto:${contact.email}` : null;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: `${t("store.contact.title")} — ${name}`,
+      description: address || pick(contact.tagline_ar, contact.tagline_en) || name,
+      canonical: absoluteUrl(window.location.href.split("#")[0], "#/store/contact") });
+    applyJsonLd(storeJsonLd(settings, window.location.href.split("#")[0]));
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [address, contact.tagline_ar, contact.tagline_en, name, pick, settings, t]);
+
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container" data-testid="v2-contact">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p><h1>{t("store.contact.title")}</h1>
+    <p className="v2-small">{pick(contact.tagline_ar, contact.tagline_en) || t("store.contact.subtitle")}</p>
+    <div className="v2-journey-grid"><div className="v2-journey-main"><V2Panel title={t("store.contact.details")}>
+      <dl className="v2-contact-list">
+        {contact.phone ? <div><dt>{t("store.contact.phone")}</dt><dd>{phoneHref ?
+          <a href={phoneHref} dir="ltr">{contact.phone}</a> : contact.phone}</dd></div> : null}
+        {contact.email ? <div><dt>{t("store.contact.email")}</dt><dd>{emailHref ?
+          <a href={emailHref}>{contact.email}</a> : contact.email}</dd></div> : null}
+        {address ? <div><dt>{t("store.contact.address")}</dt><dd>{address}{" "}
+          {map ? <a href={map} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{t("store.contact.openMap")} ↗</a> : null}</dd></div> : null}
+        {hours ? <div><dt>{t("store.contact.hours")}</dt><dd className="v2-preline">{hours}</dd></div> : null}
+      </dl>
+    </V2Panel>
+      <V2Panel title={t("store.contact.sendMessage")}><label className="v2-field">{t("store.contact.message")}
+        <textarea value={message} rows={4} onChange={(event) => setMessage(event.target.value)}
+          placeholder={t("store.contact.messagePlaceholder")} /></label>
+        {send ? <a className="v2-primary-button" href={send} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">

+    </div><aside className="v2-journey-aside">

+          href={channel.href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{channel.label} ↗</a>)}</div>
+      </V2Panel> : null}
+      {settings.delivery.enabled || settings.delivery.pickup_enabled ? <V2Panel title={t("store.footer.delivery")}>
+        {settings.delivery.enabled ? <p>{t("store.checkout.delivery")}: {settings.delivery.fee
+          ? t("store.footer.deliveryFee", { amount: money(settings.delivery.fee) }) : t("store.checkout.free")}</p> : null}
+        {settings.delivery.pickup_enabled ? <p>{t("store.footer.pickupAvailable")}
+          {pick(settings.delivery.pickup_address_ar, settings.delivery.pickup_address_en) ?
+            ` · ${pick(settings.delivery.pickup_address_ar, settings.delivery.pickup_address_en)}` : ""}</p> : null}
+        {deliveryZones.filter((zone) => zone.enabled).length > 0 ? <p className="v2-small">
+          {deliveryZones.filter((zone) => zone.enabled).map((zone) => pick(zone.name_ar, zone.name_en)).join(" · ")}</p> : null}
+      </V2Panel> : null}
+      {instapay ? <V2Panel title={t("store.checkout.instapay")}><a href={instapay} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
+        {t("store.checkout.openInstapay")} ↗</a><p className="v2-small">{t("store.contact.instapayNote")}</p></V2Panel> : null}
+    </aside></div>

+import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
+import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n, type TranslationKey } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";
+import { EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, searchCatalog } from "../services/catalogQuery";
+import { activeEditorialCampaigns, activeTrustItems } from "../services/settingsDefaults";
+import { resolvedBanners, resolvedSlides, sectionImage, sectionLimit, sectionTitle } from "../services/sections";
+import { absoluteUrl, applyDocumentMeta, applyJsonLd, clearDocumentMeta, keywordList, storeJsonLd } from "../services/seo";
+import type { HomepageSectionConfig } from "../types";
+import { V2ProductCard } from "./ProductCard";
+import { V2ActionLink, V2Image, V2ProductGrid, V2Section, V2State } from "./Primitives";
+import { resolvedV2SocialChannels } from "./SocialChannels";
+import { SocialIcon } from "../components/storefront/SocialIcon";
+import { v2Price } from "./viewModel";
+import { v2Href } from "./appearance";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Home() {
+  const { pick, t, lang } = useI18n();
+  const {
+    settings, products, categories, categoryContents, sections, catalogContext,
+    bestSellerIds, brands, faqs, reviews, loading, error, refresh,
+    variantsOf, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets,
+  } = useStorefront();
+  // The shared resolver applies ALYQ's language fallback. Keep genuinely blank
+  // fields blank rather than rendering the i18n picker's placeholder dash.
+  const slides = useMemo(() => resolvedSlides(settings, pick).map((slide) => {
+    const source = settings.images.hero_slides.find((item) => item.id === slide.id);
+    return {
+      ...slide,
+      title: source?.title_ar || source?.title_en ? slide.title : "",
+      subtitle: source?.subtitle_ar || source?.subtitle_en ? slide.subtitle : "",
+      ctaLabel: source?.cta_label_ar || source?.cta_label_en ? slide.ctaLabel : "",
+      secondaryCtaLabel: source?.secondary_cta_label_ar || source?.secondary_cta_label_en ? slide.secondaryCtaLabel : "",
+    };
+  }).filter((slide) => slide.title || slide.imageUrl || slide.mobileImageUrl), [settings, pick]);
+  const [heroIndex, setHeroIndex] = useState(0);
+  const [heroPaused, setHeroPaused] = useState(false);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (slides.length < 2 || heroPaused || window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
+    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setHeroIndex((index) => (index + 1) % slides.length), 6500);
+    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
+  }, [slides.length, heroPaused]);
+  const categoryMap = useMemo(() => new Map(categoryContents.map((row) => [row.category_id, row])), [categoryContents]);
+  const all = useMemo(() => searchCatalog(products, EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, catalogContext), [products, catalogContext]);
+  const recent = useMemo(() => searchCatalog(products, { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, sort: "newest" }, catalogContext),
+    [products, catalogContext]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const baseUrl = window.location.href.split("#")[0];
+    const storeName = pick(settings.contact.store_name_ar, settings.contact.store_name_en);
+    applyDocumentMeta({
+      title: settings.seo.meta_title.trim() || storeName,
+      description: settings.seo.meta_description.trim() ||
+        pick(settings.contact.tagline_ar, settings.contact.tagline_en) || t("store.section.hero"),
+      canonical: absoluteUrl(baseUrl, "#/store"), keywords: keywordList(settings.seo.keywords),
+      ogImage: settings.seo.og_image_url, locale: lang === "ar" ? "ar_EG" : "en_US", siteName: storeName,
+    });
+    applyJsonLd(storeJsonLd(settings, baseUrl));
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [lang, pick, settings, t]);
+
+  if (loading && products.length === 0) return <V2State kind="loading" />;
+  if (error && products.length === 0) return <V2State kind="error" onRetry={() => void refresh()} />;
+
+  function heading(section: HomepageSectionConfig) {
+    return section.title_ar || section.title_en ? sectionTitle(section, pick)
+      : t(`store.section.${section.key}` as TranslationKey);
+  }
+  function action(section: HomepageSectionConfig, fallback = "#/store/products") {
+    const label = section.cta_ar || section.cta_en ? pick(section.cta_ar, section.cta_en) : t("store.v2.viewAll");
+    return <V2ActionLink href={section.cta_href || fallback} className="v2-text-link">{label}<span aria-hidden> ↗</span></V2ActionLink>;
+  }
+
+  const render = (section: HomepageSectionConfig) => {
+    const image = section.image_url || sectionImage(settings, section.key);
+    const title = heading(section);
+    switch (section.key) {
+      case "hero": {
+        const slide = slides[heroIndex % slides.length];
+        if (!slide) return null;
+        return (
+          <section key="hero" className={`v2-hero v2-hero-${slide.height}`} aria-label={slide.title || title}
+            data-testid="v2-hero" onMouseEnter={() => setHeroPaused(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHeroPaused(false)}
+            onFocusCapture={() => setHeroPaused(true)} onBlurCapture={(event) => {
+              if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setHeroPaused(false);
+            }}>
+            {(slide.imageUrl || slide.mobileImageUrl) ? (
+              <><V2Image src={slide.imageUrl} mobileSrc={slide.mobileImageUrl} alt="" priority className="v2-hero-photo" />
+                {/* A minimum scrim keeps white copy legible even when the shared
+                    slide overlay is set to zero against a pale photograph. */}
+                <div className="v2-hero-scrim" style={{ opacity: Math.max(0.58, (slide.overlay ?? 36) / 100) }} aria-hidden /></>
+            ) : null}
+            <div className={`v2-hero-content v2-hero-${slide.contentPosition}`}>
+              <p className="v2-hero-kicker">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+              {slide.title ? <h1>{slide.title}</h1> : null}
+              {slide.subtitle ? <p className="v2-hero-subtitle">{slide.subtitle}</p> : null}
+              <div className="v2-hero-actions">
+                {slide.ctaLabel ? <V2ActionLink href={slide.ctaHref} className="v2-hero-button">{slide.ctaLabel}<span aria-hidden> ↗</span></V2ActionLink> : null}
+                {slide.secondaryCtaLabel ? <V2ActionLink href={slide.secondaryCtaHref} className="v2-hero-secondary">{slide.secondaryCtaLabel}</V2ActionLink> : null}
+              </div>
+            </div>
+            {slides.length > 1 ? <div className="v2-hero-pages" role="group" aria-label={t("store.v2.gallery")}>
+              {slides.map((item, index) => <button key={item.id} type="button" aria-pressed={index === heroIndex % slides.length}
+                aria-label={t("store.product.viewImage", { number: index + 1 })}
+                onClick={() => setHeroIndex(index)} />)}
+              <span aria-hidden>{String(heroIndex % slides.length + 1).padStart(2, "0")} / {String(slides.length).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
+            </div> : null}
+          </section>
+        );
+      }
+      case "categories": {
+        const active = categories.filter((category) => category.active && products.some((product) => product.category_id === category.id));
+        const curated = section.category_ids?.length ? section.category_ids
+          : categoryContents.filter((row) => row.featured).sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order).map((row) => row.category_id);
+        const ids = curated.length ? curated : active.map((row) => row.id);
+        const entries = ids.map((id) => active.find((row) => row.id === id)).filter((row) => row !== undefined).slice(0, sectionLimit(section));
+        if (!entries.length) return null;
+        return (
+          <V2Section key="categories" id="categories" title={title} eyebrow={t("store.v2.eyebrow")} action={action(section)}>
+            <div className="v2-category-grid">
+              {entries.map((category) => {
+                const content = categoryMap.get(category.id);
+                const label = pick(content?.title_ar || category.name_ar, content?.title_en || category.name_en);
+                const cover = content?.homepage_image_url || content?.image_url || image ||
+                  products.find((product) => product.category_id === category.id)?.image_url;
+                return (
+                  <Link key={category.id} to={`/store/products?category=${encodeURIComponent(category.id)}`} className="v2-category">
+                    <V2Image src={cover} alt="" />
+                    <span className="v2-category-title">{label}<span aria-hidden> ↗</span></span>
+                  </Link>
+                );
+              })}
+            </div>
+          </V2Section>
+        );
+      }
+      case "featured":
+      case "bestSellers":
+      case "newArrivals":
+      case "collection":
+      case "sale": {
+        let entries = section.key === "featured" ? all.filter((entry) => entry.product.is_featured)
+          : section.key === "bestSellers" ? bestSellerIds.map((id) => all.find((entry) => entry.product.id === id)).filter((row) => row !== undefined)
+            : section.key === "newArrivals" ? recent.filter((entry) => entry.isNew)
+              : section.key === "collection" ? (section.product_ids ?? []).map((id) => all.find((entry) => entry.product.id === id)).filter((row) => row !== undefined)
+                : all.filter((entry) => {
+                  const price = v2Price(entry.product, variantsOf(entry.product.id), campaigns,
+                    promotions, promotionTargets, null, catalogContext.reservedVariant);
+                  return price.price < price.list;
+                });
+        entries = entries.slice(0, sectionLimit(section));
+        if (entries.length === 0) return null;
+        return (
+          <V2Section key={section.key} id={section.key} title={title} eyebrow={t("store.v2.eyebrow")}
+            action={action(section, section.key === "sale" ? "#/store/products?offer=1"
+              : section.key === "newArrivals" ? "#/store/products?sort=newest"
+                : section.key === "bestSellers" ? "#/store/products?sort=best_selling" : "#/store/products")}>
+            <V2ProductGrid>{entries.map((entry, index) => <V2ProductCard key={entry.product.id} entry={entry} priority={index < 2} />)}</V2ProductGrid>
+          </V2Section>
+        );
+      }
+      case "campaigns": {
+        const blocks = activeEditorialCampaigns(settings).filter((item) => item.placement === "homepage").slice(0, sectionLimit(section));
+        if (!blocks.length) return null;
+        return (
+          <V2Section key="campaigns" id="campaigns" title={title}>
+            <div className="v2-editorial-stack">
+              {blocks.map((block) => <div key={block.id} className="v2-editorial v2-campaign">
+                <V2Image src={block.desktop_image_url} mobileSrc={block.mobile_image_url} alt="" />
+                <div className="v2-editorial-copy"><p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p>
+                  <h3>{pick(block.title_ar, block.title_en)}</h3>
+                  {block.subtitle_ar || block.subtitle_en ? <p>{pick(block.subtitle_ar, block.subtitle_en)}</p> : null}
+                  {block.cta_ar || block.cta_en ? <V2ActionLink href={block.cta_href} className="v2-text-link">{pick(block.cta_ar, block.cta_en)} ↗</V2ActionLink> : null}
+                </div>
+              </div>)}</div>
+          </V2Section>
+        );
+      }
+      case "promoBanners": {
+        const banners = resolvedBanners(settings, pick);
+        if (!banners.length) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="promoBanners" title={title}><div className="v2-promo-row">
+          {banners.map((banner) => {
+            const raw = settings.images.promo_banners.find((entry) => entry.id === banner.id);
+            const details = <>{banner.imageUrl ? <V2Image src={banner.imageUrl} alt="" /> : null}
+              <span>{raw?.badge_ar || raw?.badge_en ? <small>{banner.badge}</small> : null}
+                {raw?.title_ar || raw?.title_en ? <strong>{banner.title}</strong> : null}
+                {raw?.caption_ar || raw?.caption_en ? <span>{banner.caption}</span> : null}</span></>;
+            return v2Href(banner.href) ? <V2ActionLink key={banner.id} href={banner.href} className="v2-promo-card">
+              {details}</V2ActionLink> : <div key={banner.id} className="v2-promo-card">{details}</div>;
+          })}
+        </div></V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "lookbook":
+      case "editorial":
+      case "textImage":
+      case "aboutPreview": {
+        const about = section.key === "aboutPreview";
+        const body = about ? (settings.about.body_ar || settings.about.body_en
+          ? pick(settings.about.body_ar, settings.about.body_en) : "")
+          : section.body_ar || section.body_en ? pick(section.body_ar, section.body_en) : "";
+        const cover = image || (about ? settings.about.image_url : null);
+        if (!body && !cover) return null;
+        const link = about ? settings.about.cta_href : section.cta_href;
+        const cta = about ? (settings.about.cta_ar || settings.about.cta_en
+          ? pick(settings.about.cta_ar, settings.about.cta_en) : "")
+          : section.cta_ar || section.cta_en ? pick(section.cta_ar, section.cta_en) : "";
+        return <V2Section key={section.key} id={section.key} title={title} className="v2-editorial-section">
+          <div className="v2-editorial">
+            {cover ? <V2Image src={cover} mobileSrc={section.mobile_image_url} alt="" /> : null}
+            <div className="v2-editorial-copy"><p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.stories")}</p>
+              <h3>{title}</h3>{body ? <p>{body}</p> : null}
+              {cta ? <V2ActionLink href={link} className="v2-text-link">{cta} ↗</V2ActionLink> : null}
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        </V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "trustStrip": {
+        const items = activeTrustItems(settings).slice(0, 4);
+        return items.length ? <V2Section key="trustStrip" id="trustStrip" title={title}><div className="v2-trust-grid">
+          {items.map((item) => <div key={item.id} className="v2-trust-item"><span aria-hidden>✦</span>
+            <strong>{pick(item.title_ar, item.title_en)}</strong>
+            {item.desc_ar || item.desc_en ? <p>{pick(item.desc_ar, item.desc_en)}</p> : null}</div>)}
+        </div></V2Section> : null;
+      }
+      case "newsletter": {
+        const email = settings.contact.email.trim();
+        if (!email.includes("@")) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="newsletter" id="newsletter" title={title} className="v2-newsletter-section">
+          <div className="v2-newsletter"><p>{section.body_ar || section.body_en ? pick(section.body_ar, section.body_en) : t("store.v2.newsletterIntro")}</p>
+            <a href={`mailto:${encodeURIComponent(email)}?subject=${encodeURIComponent("ALYQ news")}`}
+              className="v2-outline-button">{t("store.v2.newsletterAction")} ↗</a>
+            <small>{t("store.v2.newsletterNote")}</small>
+          </div>
+        </V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "brands": {
+        if (!brands.length) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="brands" title={title}><div className="v2-chip-row">{brands.map((brand) => (
+          <Link key={brand.name_en || brand.name_ar} to={`/store/products?brand=${encodeURIComponent(brand.name_en || brand.name_ar)}`}
+            className="v2-category-chip">{pick(brand.name_ar, brand.name_en)}</Link>
+        ))}</div></V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "reviews": {
+        const visible = reviews.filter((review) => review.visible && review.product_id === null).slice(0, section.limit);
+        if (!visible.length) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="reviews" title={title}><div className="v2-review-grid">{visible.map((review) => (
+          <blockquote key={review.id}><span aria-label={`${review.rating}/5`}>{"★".repeat(review.rating)}</span><p>{review.body}</p><cite>{review.author_name}</cite></blockquote>
+        ))}</div></V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "faq": {
+        const visible = faqs.filter((faq) => faq.active).slice(0, section.limit);
+        if (!visible.length) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="faq" title={title}><div className="v2-faq">{visible.map((faq) => (
+          <details key={faq.id}><summary>{pick(faq.question_ar, faq.question_en)}</summary><p>{pick(faq.answer_ar, faq.answer_en)}</p></details>
+        ))}</div></V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "socialGallery": {
+        // The optional editorial social section shows profiles; WhatsApp has
+        // one deliberate contact action in the footer instead of a third CTA.
+        const links = resolvedV2SocialChannels(settings, lang).filter((link) => link.platform !== "whatsapp");
+        if (!links.length) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="socialGallery" title={title}><div className="v2-chip-row">
+          {links.map((link) => <V2ActionLink key={link.platform} href={link.href}
+            className="v2-category-chip v2-social-gallery-link">
+            <SocialIcon kind={link.platform} />{link.label}
+          </V2ActionLink>)}
+        </div></V2Section>;
+      }
+      case "contact": {
+        if (!settings.contact.phone && !settings.contact.email) return null;
+        return <V2Section key="contact" title={title}><div className="v2-contact-band">
+          <p>{pick(settings.contact.address_ar, settings.contact.address_en)}</p>
+          <Link to="/store/contact" className="v2-text-link">{t("store.nav.contact")} ↗</Link>
+        </div></V2Section>;
+      }
+    }
+  };
+
+  const rendered = sections.map(render).filter(Boolean);
+  return <div className="v2-home" data-testid="v2-home">{rendered.length ? rendered : (
+    <div className="v2-container v2-home-empty"><V2State kind="empty" />
+      <Link to="/store/products" className="v2-outline-button">{t("store.product.browseAll")} ↗</Link>
+    </div>
+  )}</div>;
+}

+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStorefront } from "../hooks/StorefrontProvider";

+export function StorefrontV2Product() {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { key = "" } = useParams<{ key: string }>();
+  const { products, contents, catalogContext, loading, error, refresh } = useStorefront();
+  const product = useMemo(() => findCatalogProduct(key, products, contents), [key, products, contents]);
+  const entry = useMemo(() => product
+    ? searchCatalog(products, { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, productIds: [product.id] }, catalogContext)
+      .find((candidate) => candidate.product.id === product.id) ?? null : null,
+  [product, products, catalogContext]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (entry || loading) return;
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: t("common.notFound"), description: t("store.product.notFoundHint"), noIndex: true });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [entry, loading, t]);
+  if (loading && products.length === 0) return <V2State kind="loading" />;
+  if (error && products.length === 0) return <V2State kind="error" onRetry={() => void refresh()} />;
+  if (!product || !entry) return <div className="v2-container v2-not-found">
+    <h1>{t("common.notFound")}</h1>
+    <p>{t("store.product.notFoundHint")}</p>
+    <Link to="/store/products" className="v2-outline-button">{t("store.product.browseAll")} ↗</Link>
+  </div>;
+  return <V2Detail key={product.id} product={product} entry={entry} />;
+}

+function V2Detail({ product, entry }: { product: Product; entry: CatalogProduct }) {
+  const { t, pick, lang } = useI18n();
+  const { settings, contentByProduct, products, catalogContext, categories, mode,
+    variantsOf, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets, reviews } = useStorefront();
+  const { add, setQuantity, lines } = useStoreCart();
+  const { inWishlist, toggleWishlist } = useStoreAccount();
+  const content: ProductContent | null = contentByProduct.get(product.id) ?? null;
+  const variants = variantsOf(product.id);
+  const model = useMemo(() => variantModel(variants, catalogContext.reservedVariant, product.stock_tracking_enabled),
+    [variants, catalogContext.reservedVariant, product.stock_tracking_enabled]);
+  const [color, setColor] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [quantity, setQuantityDraft] = useState(1);
+  const [imageIndex, setImageIndex] = useState(0);
+  const [zoomOpen, setZoomOpen] = useState(false);
+  const openZoomButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const zoomCloseButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const sizeGuide = useRef<HTMLDetailsElement>(null);
+  const [added, setAdded] = useState(false);
+  const selected = product.variants_enabled
+    ? model.variants.find((variant) => variant.id === selectedId && model.remaining(variant) > 0) ?? null
+    : null;
+  const price = v2Price(product, variants, campaigns, promotions, promotionTargets,
+    selected, catalogContext.reservedVariant);
+  const badges = entry.badges.filter((badge) => badge === "new" ? settings.badges.show_new
+    : badge === "sale" ? settings.badges.show_sale
+      : badge === "bestSeller" ? settings.badges.show_best_seller
+        : badge === "featured");
+  if (settings.badges.show_sale && price.price < price.list && !badges.includes("sale")) badges.unshift("sale");
+  const limited = settings.badges.show_limited && product.stock_tracking_enabled &&
+    entry.available !== null && entry.available > 0 && entry.available <= product.low_stock_level;
+  const category = categories.find((candidate) => candidate.id === product.category_id);
+  const name = pick(product.name_ar, product.name_en);
+  const gallery = useMemo(() => {
+    const original = [product.image_url, ...product.images,
+      ...(content?.media?.slice().sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order).map((item) => item.url) ?? [])]
+      .filter((url): url is string => Boolean(url?.trim()));
+    return [...new Set(selected?.image_url ? [selected.image_url, ...original] : original)];
+  }, [product.image_url, product.images, content?.media, selected?.image_url]);
+  const sections = productContentSections(content);
+  const hasSizeGuide = sections.some((section) => section.key === "dimensions");
+  const available = product.variants_enabled ? selected ? model.remaining(selected) : 0 : entry.available ?? 0;
+  const orderable = product.stock_tracking_enabled && (product.variants_enabled ? Boolean(selected) : entry.inStock);
+  const max = Math.min(99, Math.max(available, 0));
+  const wished = inWishlist(product.id);
+  const related = useMemo(() => relatedProducts(product, products, catalogContext, 4),
+    [product, products, catalogContext]);
+  const productReviews = reviews.filter((review) => review.visible && review.product_id === product.id);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const baseUrl = window.location.href.split("#")[0];
+    const storeName = pick(settings.contact.store_name_ar, settings.contact.store_name_en);
+    applyDocumentMeta({
+      title: titleForProduct({ name, seoTitle: content?.seo_title, storeName }),

+      canonical: absoluteUrl(baseUrl, productPath(product, content)),

+    });
+    applyJsonLd(productJsonLd({ product, content,
+      categoryName: category ? pick(category.name_ar, category.name_en) : null,
+      price: price.price, baseUrl, storeName, pick }));
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [category, content, gallery, lang, name, pick, price.price, product, settings.contact.store_name_ar,
+    settings.contact.store_name_en, settings.seo.og_image_url]);

+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!zoomOpen) return;
+    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;
+    const trigger = openZoomButton.current;
+    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
+    zoomCloseButton.current?.focus();
+    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); setZoomOpen(false); }
+      if (event.key === "ArrowRight") setImageIndex((index) => (index + 1) % gallery.length);
+      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") setImageIndex((index) => (index + gallery.length - 1) % gallery.length);
+      if (event.key === "Tab") {
+        const options = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".v2-lightbox button:not(:disabled)")];
+        if (!options.length) return;
+        if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === options[0]) {
+          event.preventDefault(); options.at(-1)?.focus();
+        } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === options.at(-1)) {
+          event.preventDefault(); options[0].focus();
+        }
+      }
+    };
+    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
+    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = previous;
+      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey); trigger?.focus(); };
+  }, [zoomOpen, gallery.length]);
+
+  const chooseVariant = (variant: typeof selected, colorKey: string | null) => {
+    setColor(colorKey);
+    setSelectedId(variant?.id ?? null);
+    setImageIndex(0);
+    setAdded(false);
+  };
+  const addToBag = () => {
+    if (!orderable || (product.variants_enabled && !selected)) return;
+    const already = lines.find((line) => line.product_id === product.id &&
+      (line.variant_id ?? null) === (selected?.id ?? null))?.quantity ?? 0;
+    const next = Math.min(already + quantity, max);
+    if (next <= already) return;
+    if (already > 0) setQuantity(product.id, selected?.id ?? null, next);
+    else add(product, Math.min(quantity, max), selected);
+    setAdded(true);
+  };

+        {pick(category.name_ar, category.name_en)}</Link></> : null}
+      <span aria-hidden>/</span><span aria-current="page">{name}</span>
+    </nav>
+    <div className="v2-pdp-layout">
+      <div className="v2-pdp-gallery">
+        <div className="v2-pdp-main-image"><button type="button" ref={openZoomButton} className="v2-pdp-zoom"
+          disabled={!gallery.length} aria-label={t("store.product.viewImage", { number: imageIndex + 1 })}
+          onClick={() => setZoomOpen(true)} data-testid="v2-image-zoom">

+            {limited && badges.length < 2 ? <span className="v2-badge">{t("store.v2.limited")}</span> : null}
+          </span> : null}
+        </div>
+        {gallery.length > 1 ? <div className="v2-pdp-thumbnails" role="group" aria-label={t("store.v2.gallery")}>
+          {gallery.map((url, index) => <button key={url} type="button" className="v2-pdp-thumb"
+            aria-label={t("store.product.viewImage", { number: index + 1 })} aria-pressed={imageIndex === index}
+            onClick={() => setImageIndex(index)}><V2Image src={url} alt="" /></button>)}
+        </div> : null}
+        {gallery.length ? <p className="v2-size-note">{t("store.product.zoomHint")}</p> : null}
+        {zoomOpen && gallery.length ? <div className="v2-lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"

+              onClick={() => setImageIndex((index) => (index + gallery.length - 1) % gallery.length)}>‹</button>

+      <V2ProductGrid>{related.map((item) => <V2ProductCard key={item.product.id} entry={item} />)}</V2ProductGrid>
+    </V2Section> : null}

+import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

+    drawerRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="v2-menu-close"]')?.focus();
+    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+      if (event.key === "Escape") {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        setMenuOpen(false);
+      }
+      if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
+      const focusable = [...(drawerRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
+        'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),[tabindex="0"]',
+      ) ?? [])].filter((node) => node.getClientRects().length > 0);
+      if (!focusable.length) return;
+      const first = focusable[0];
+      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
+      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { event.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
+      else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
+    };
+    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
+    return () => {
+      document.body.style.overflow = previous;
+      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
+      if (previouslyFocused?.isConnected) previouslyFocused.focus();
+      else trigger?.focus();
+    };
+  }, [menuOpen]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    // Back/forward navigation while the drawer is open must not leave a body lock.
+    setMenuOpen(false);
+    setSearchOpen(false);
+  }, [location.pathname]);
+
+  const closeAndNavigate = (path: string) => { setMenuOpen(false); navigate(path); };
+  const submitSearch = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const q = search.trim();
+    setSearchOpen(false);
+    navigate(`/store/products${q ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}`);
+  };
+  const message = messages[(reducedMotion ? 0 : messageIndex) % (messages.length || 1)];
+  const scroll = settings.announcement.mode === "scroll";
+  // Clamped shared cadence controls scroll speed too; long copy gets time to
+  // pass without a new V2-only timing setting.
+  const tickerDuration = `${Math.max(12, Math.min(180, (announcementIntervalMs(settings) / 1000) * messages.length))}s`;
+  const announcementContent = (item: (typeof messages)[number], duplicate = false) => {
+    const content = `${pick(item.text_ar, item.text_en)}${item.cta_ar || item.cta_en ? ` · ${pick(item.cta_ar, item.cta_en)}` : ""}`;
+    const href = item.href ?? settings.announcement.href;
+    return href && !duplicate && v2Href(href)
+      ? <V2ActionLink href={href} className="v2-announcement-link">{content}</V2ActionLink>
+      : <span>{content}</span>;
+  };
+  const newsletterEmail = settings.contact.email.trim();
+
+  return (
+    <div className="store-v2" dir={dir} style={appearance.variables} data-testid="store-v2">
+      <a href="#v2-main" className="v2-skip" onClick={(event) => {
+        // HashRouter owns the fragment. Native #v2-main navigation would be
+        // mistaken for a route and send the shopper to the login fallback.
+        event.preventDefault();
+        document.getElementById("v2-main")?.focus();
+      }}>{t("store.v2.skip")}</a>
+      {settings.announcement.enabled && message ? (
+        <div className={`v2-announcement${scroll ? " v2-announcement-scroll" : ""}`}
+          role="region" aria-label={t("store.announcements.label")}

+                {messages.map((item) => <span className="v2-announcement-item" key={item.id}>{announcementContent(item)}</span>)}
+              </div>
+              <div className="v2-announcement-copy" aria-hidden="true">
+                {messages.map((item) => <span className="v2-announcement-item" key={item.id}>{announcementContent(item, true)}</span>)}
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          </div> : <span aria-live={settings.announcement.mode === "rotate" && !reducedMotion ? "polite" : "off"}>

+              data-testid="v2-menu-open" aria-label={t("store.nav.menu")} aria-expanded={menuOpen}
+              aria-controls="v2-drawer" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}><Icon name="menu" /></button>
+            {appearance.showSearch ? (
+              <button type="button" className="v2-icon-button" aria-label={t("store.search.label")}

+/** Private order tracking. The existing lookupOrder(reference, phone) is the
+ * only read; an order number in the URL is not enough to reveal a record. */
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
+import { Link, useLocation, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import { useStoreAccount } from "../hooks/StoreAccountProvider";
+import { applyDocumentMeta, clearDocumentMeta } from "../services/seo";
+import type { OnlineOrder } from "../types";
+import { V2OrderDetails, V2Panel, V2ProofPanel } from "./JourneyParts";
+
+export function StorefrontV2Track() {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { track } = useStoreAccount();
+  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
+  const location = useLocation();
+  const state = location.state as { number?: string; phone?: string } | null;
+  const [number, setNumber] = useState(params.get("number") || state?.number || "");
+  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(state?.phone || "");
+  const [order, setOrder] = useState<OnlineOrder | null>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
+  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
+  const request = useRef(0);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    applyDocumentMeta({ title: t("store.track.title"), description: "", noIndex: true });
+    return () => clearDocumentMeta();
+  }, [t]);
+  useEffect(() => () => { request.current += 1; }, []);
+  const submit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    setTouched(true);
+    setError(false);
+    setOrder(null);
+    if (!number.trim() || !phone.trim()) return;
+    const id = ++request.current;
+    setLoading(true);
+    // A shareable order reference is harmless by itself. Never put the phone
+    // or an order object in the hash/query string.
+    setParams(number.trim() ? { number: number.trim() } : {}, { replace: true });
+    try {
+      const found = await track(number.trim(), phone.trim());
+      if (request.current === id) { setOrder(found); setError(!found); }
+    } catch {
+      if (request.current === id) setError(true);
+    } finally {
+      if (request.current === id) setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return <div className="v2-journey v2-container" data-testid="v2-track">
+    <p className="v2-eyebrow">{t("store.v2.eyebrow")}</p><h1>{t("store.track.title")}</h1>
+    <p className="v2-small">{t("store.track.hint")}</p>
+    <div className="v2-journey-grid"><div className="v2-journey-main">
+      <V2Panel><form className="v2-track-form" onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} noValidate>
+        <label className="v2-field">{t("store.confirmation.orderNumber")}
+          <input dir="ltr" autoComplete="off" value={number} onChange={(event) => { setNumber(event.target.value); setOrder(null); }}
+            required aria-invalid={touched && !number.trim()} />
+        </label>
+        <label className="v2-field">{t("store.checkout.phone")}
+          <input dir="ltr" type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" value={phone}
+            onChange={(event) => { setPhone(event.target.value); setOrder(null); }}
+            required aria-invalid={touched && !phone.trim()} />
+        </label>
+        {touched && (!number.trim() || !phone.trim()) ? <p role="alert" className="v2-field-error">
+          {t("store.v2.journey.trackBoth")}</p> : null}
+        <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="v2-primary-button" data-testid="v2-track-submit">
+          {loading ? t("common.loading") : t("store.track.search")}</button>
+      </form></V2Panel>
+      {error ? <V2Panel><p role="alert" className="v2-alert" data-testid="v2-track-error">
+        {t("store.track.notFound")}</p><p className="v2-small">{t("store.track.notFoundHint")}</p></V2Panel> : null}
+      {order ? <div data-testid="v2-tracked-order"><V2Panel>
+        <p className="v2-small">{t("store.confirmation.orderNumber")}</p>
+        <h2 dir="ltr">{order.order_number}</h2>
+        <div className="v2-order-badges"><span>{t(`online.status.${order.status}` as never)}</span>
+          <span>{t(`online.paymentStatus.${order.payment_status}` as never)}</span></div>
+      </V2Panel><V2ProofPanel order={order} /><V2OrderDetails order={order} timeline />
+      </div> : null}
+    </div><aside className="v2-journey-aside"><V2Panel title={t("store.confirmation.whatHappensNext")}>
+      <p className="v2-small">{t("store.confirmation.step3")}</p>
+      <Link to="/store/contact" className="v2-text-link">{t("store.nav.contact")} ↗</Link>
+    </V2Panel></aside></div>
+  </div>;
+}

+import { useI18n } from "@/lib/i18n/I18nProvider";
+import type { StoreVariant } from "../services/pricing";
+import { variantColorLabel } from "../services/variantLabel";
+import { variantModel } from "./variantModel";
+
+/** Same explicit, exact-shelf chooser on a card and on the V2 PDP. A size key
+ * is derived from the saved numeric size or the saved size_label (XS / One Size
+ * / any future size); no list of clothing sizes is embedded in the UI.
+ */
+export function V2VariantChooser({ model, colorKey, variantId, onChoice, compact = false }: {
+  model: ReturnType<typeof variantModel>;
+  colorKey: string | null;
+  variantId: string | null;
+  onChoice: (variant: StoreVariant | null, colorKey: string | null) => void;
+  compact?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const { t, lang } = useI18n();
+  const selectedColor = model.hasColors ? colorKey : "";
+  const group = model.groups.find((item) => item.color_key === selectedColor);
+
+  return (
+    <div className={`v2-variant-chooser ${compact ? "v2-variant-compact" : ""}`} data-testid="v2-variant-picker">
+      {model.hasColors ? (
+        <div role="group" aria-label={t("store.variants.color")}>
+          <p className="v2-picker-label">{t("store.variants.color")}
+            {group ? <span> — {variantColorLabel(group, lang)}</span> : null}
+          </p>
+          <div className="v2-picker-options">
+            {model.groups.map((item) => {
+              const name = variantColorLabel(item, lang) || t("store.variants.defaultColor");
+              const out = !item.variants.some((variant) => model.remaining(variant) > 0);
+              return (
+                <button
+                  key={item.color_key}
+                  type="button"
+                  className="v2-color-option"
+                  data-testid={`v2-color-${item.color_key}`}
+                  data-selected={selectedColor === item.color_key}
+                  aria-label={`${t("store.variants.color")}: ${name}${out ? ` — ${t("store.variants.soldOut")}` : ""}`}
+                  aria-pressed={selectedColor === item.color_key}
+                  onClick={() => onChoice(model.hasSizes ? null : model.exact(item.color_key, ""), item.color_key)}
+                >
+                  {item.color_hex ? <span className="v2-swatch" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color_hex }} aria-hidden /> : null}
+                  <span>{name}</span>
+                  {out ? <span className="v2-option-out" aria-hidden>×</span> : null}
+                </button>
+              );
+            })}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      ) : null}
+
+      {model.hasSizes ? (
+        <div role="group" aria-label={t("store.variants.size")}>
+          <p className="v2-picker-label">{t("store.variants.size")}</p>
+          {!group && model.hasColors ? (
+            <p className="v2-picker-hint">{t("store.variants.pickColorFirst")}</p>
+          ) : (
+            <div className="v2-picker-options">
+              {model.sizesFor(selectedColor).map(({ variant, key, label, available }) => (
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  key={variant.id}
+                  className="v2-size-option"
+                  data-testid={`v2-size-${label}`}
+                  data-selected={variant.id === variantId}
+                  aria-pressed={variant.id === variantId}
+                  title={available <= 0 ? t("store.variants.soldOut") : label}
+                  aria-label={`${t("store.variants.size")}: ${label}${available <= 0 ? ` — ${t("store.variants.soldOut")}` : ""}`}
+                  disabled={available <= 0}
+                  onClick={() => onChoice(model.exact(selectedColor, key), selectedColor)}
+                >
+                  {label || t("store.variants.defaultColor")}
+                </button>
+              ))}
+            </div>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      ) : null}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+ test("receipt storage holds only a temporary reference+phone pair; refresh always needs private lookup", () => {
+  const data = new Map<string, string>();
+  const storage = { getItem: (key: string) => data.get(key) ?? null,
+    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => { data.set(key, value); },
+    removeItem: (key: string) => { data.delete(key); } };
+  rememberV2Receipt(historic, storage);
+  const raw = data.get(V2_RECEIPT_KEY) ?? "";
+  assert.ok(raw.includes("WEB-000421") && raw.includes("01012345678"));
+  assert.ok(!raw.includes("items") && !raw.includes("subtotal") && !raw.includes("customer_name"));
+  const pair = readV2Receipt(storage);
+  assert.deepEqual({ order: pair?.order, phone: pair?.phone }, { order: historic.order_number,
+    phone: historic.customer_phone });
+  assert.equal(readV2Receipt(storage, Date.now() + 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000), null);
+  assert.equal(storage.getItem(V2_RECEIPT_KEY), null, "expired pair removed");
+  data.set(V2_RECEIPT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ order: "WEB-000421", at: Date.now() }));
+  assert.equal(readV2Receipt(storage), null, "reference alone is insufficient");
+  data.set(V2_RECEIPT_KEY, "invalid JSON");
+  assert.equal(readV2Receipt(storage), null, "bad storage never renders an order");
+  assert.equal(readV2Receipt({ getItem: () => { throw Error("blocked"); }, setItem: () => {}, removeItem: () => {} }), null);
+});

+test("checkout guard mirrors delivery zone/phone/minimum and rejects unavailable fulfilment/stock", () => {
+  const settings = structuredClone(DEFAULT_WEBSITE_SETTINGS);
+  settings.delivery.enabled = true;
+  settings.delivery.pickup_enabled = true;
+  settings.delivery.cod_enabled = true;
+  settings.delivery.instapay_enabled = true;
+  settings.delivery.minimum_order = 90;
+  const zone = { id: "cairo", enabled: true, minimum_order_amount: 120 } as DeliveryZone;
+  const fields = { name: "Shopper", phone: "01012345678", address, deliveryType: "delivery" as const,
+    deliveryZoneId: "cairo", goodsTotal: 150, blockedLines: 0 };
+  const okay = v2CheckoutIssues(fields, settings, [zone]);
+  assert.equal(okay.phone || okay.name || okay.address || okay.zone || okay.area || okay.fulfilment ||
+    okay.payment || okay.stock || okay.shortfall > 0, false);
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, phone: "123" }, settings, [zone]).phone, true);
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, deliveryZoneId: null }, settings, [zone]).zone, true);
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, goodsTotal: 100 }, settings, [zone]).shortfall, 20);
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, blockedLines: 1 }, settings, [zone]).stock, true);
+  settings.delivery.enabled = false;
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues(fields, settings, [zone]).fulfilment, true);
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, deliveryType: "pickup" }, settings, [zone]).fulfilment, false);
+  settings.delivery.cod_enabled = false; settings.delivery.instapay_enabled = false;
+  assert.equal(v2CheckoutIssues({ ...fields, deliveryType: "pickup" }, settings, [zone]).payment, true);
+});

+test("reorder requires the published exact variant and sufficient shelf stock (including existing cart)", () => {
+  const plan = planV2Reorder(historic, [one], [gold17, gold18, silver17, silverM]);
+  assert.deepEqual(plan.ready, [{ product_id: one.id, variant_id: gold17.id, quantity: 1 }]);
+  assert.deepEqual(plan.unavailable, []);
+  const missing = planV2Reorder(historic, [one], [silver17]);
+  assert.deepEqual(missing.ready, []);
+  assert.deepEqual(missing.unavailable, [gold17.sku], "silver size 17 never replaces missing gold size 17");
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(historic, [one], [{ ...gold17, active: false }]).unavailable, [gold17.sku]);
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(historic, [one], [gold17], new Map(), new Map([[gold17.id, 2]]),
+    [{ product_id: one.id, variant_id: gold17.id, quantity: 1 }]).unavailable, [gold17.sku]);
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(historic, [{ ...one, show_on_website: false }], [gold17]).unavailable, [gold17.sku]);
+  const oldWithoutVariant = { ...historic, items: [{ ...historic.items[0], variant_id: null }] } as OnlineOrder;
+  assert.equal(planV2Reorder(oldWithoutVariant, [one], [gold17]).ready.length, 0,
+    "historic product-only line cannot turn into a guessed size");
+});

+test("a published stock-tracked simple product reorders without inventing a variant", () => {
+  const simple = { ...one, id: "simple", sku: "SKU-SIMPLE", variants_enabled: false, stock_quantity: 4 };
+  const item = { ...historic.items[0], product_id: simple.id, variant_id: null,
+    sku: simple.sku, quantity: 2 };
+  const order = { ...historic, items: [item] } as OnlineOrder;
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(order, [simple], []), {
+    ready: [{ product_id: simple.id, variant_id: null, quantity: 2 }], unavailable: [],
+  });
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(order, [{ ...simple, stock_quantity: 1 }], []).unavailable,
+    [item.sku], "current simple-product stock limits the reorder");
+  assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(order, [simple], [], new Map([[simple.id, 3]])).unavailable,
+    [item.sku], "existing reservations limit the same current shelf");
+});

+test("unpublished, inactive, untracked and sold-out historical products cannot enter a reorder", () => {
+  const cases = [
+    [{ ...one, show_on_website: false }, [gold17], "unpublished product"],
+    [{ ...one, active: false }, [gold17], "archived product"],
+    [{ ...one, stock_tracking_enabled: false }, [gold17], "tracking-disabled product"],
+    [one, [{ ...gold17, active: false }], "inactive exact variant"],
+    [one, [], "unpublished exact variant"],
+    [one, [{ ...gold17, stock_quantity: 0 }], "sold-out exact variant"],
+    [one, [{ ...gold17, product_id: "another-product" }], "UUID owned by another product"],
+    [{ ...one, variants_enabled: false }, [gold17], "product no longer sells by variant"],
+  ] as const;
+  for (const [product, variants, label] of cases) {
+    assert.deepEqual(planV2Reorder(historic, [product], variants),
+      { ready: [], unavailable: [gold17.sku] }, label);
+  }
+});

+test("partial reorder keeps only currently valid exact UUIDs and identifies every refused SKU", () => {
+  const simple = { ...one, id: "simple", sku: "SKU-SIMPLE", variants_enabled: false, stock_quantity: 4 };
+  const simpleItem = { ...historic.items[0], product_id: simple.id, variant_id: null, sku: simple.sku };
+  const unavailableItem = { ...historic.items[0], variant_id: gold18.id, sku: gold18.sku };
+  const order = { ...historic, items: [simpleItem, historic.items[0], unavailableItem] } as OnlineOrder;
+  const plan = planV2Reorder(order, [simple, one], [silver17, gold17, gold18]);
+  assert.deepEqual(plan.ready, [
+    { product_id: simple.id, variant_id: null, quantity: 1 },
+    { product_id: one.id, variant_id: gold17.id, quantity: 1 },
+  ]);
+  assert.deepEqual(plan.unavailable, [gold18.sku]);
+  assert.equal(plan.ready.some((line) => line.variant_id === silver17.id), false,
+    "same-size silver is never silently substituted for the unavailable gold shelf");
+  const allUnavailable = planV2Reorder({ ...order, items: [unavailableItem] }, [simple, one],
+    [silver17, gold18]);
+  assert.deepEqual(allUnavailable, { ready: [], unavailable: [gold18.sku] });
+});

+test("repeated historical lines never promise more stock than the exact shelf holds", () => {
+  const two = { ...historic.items[0], quantity: 2 };
+  const result = planV2Reorder({ ...historic, items: [two, two] } as OnlineOrder, [one], [gold17]);
+  assert.deepEqual(result, { ready: [{ product_id: one.id, variant_id: gold17.id, quantity: 2 }],
+    unavailable: [gold17.sku] });
+});

+test("URL-backed numeric/letter-size + color facets select a single matching shelf", () => {
+  const filters = { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, color: "silver", sizeLabel: "M" };
+  const roundTrip = filtersFromSearchParams(filtersToSearchParams(filters));
+  assert.equal(roundTrip.sizeLabel, "M");
+  assert.deepEqual(searchCatalog([one], roundTrip, context).map((row) => row.product.id), [one.id]);
+  assert.equal(searchCatalog([one], { ...filters, color: "gold" }, context).length, 0,
+    "gold 17 + silver M cannot form an imaginary combination");
+  assert.equal(searchCatalog([one], { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, color: "gold", size: 18,
+    availability: "in_stock" }, context).length, 0);
+  assert.equal(searchCatalog([one], { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, color: "gold", size: 18,
+    availability: "out_of_stock" }, context).length, 1);
+  assert.equal(searchCatalog([one], { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, color: "silver", size: 17,
+    availability: "in_stock" }, context).length, 1, "one unit remains after the hold");
+  const narrowed = v2CatalogResults([one], { ...filters, availability: "in_stock" }, context, [], [], []);
+  assert.equal(narrowed[0]?.available, 3);
+  assert.deepEqual(v2CatalogResults([one], { ...EMPTY_CATALOG_FILTERS, color: "gold", size: 18,
+    availability: "out_of_stock" }, context, [], [], []).map((row) => row.available), [0]);
+});

+test("all new journey/advisory copy is translated in both directions", () => {

+/** Storefront V2's presentation adapter. The admin saves a small typed group
+ * inside the existing website_settings JSON document. Only this V2 root receives
+ * the tokens; legacy storefront, POS and Admin never read or inherit them. */
+import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
+import type { StorefrontV2Settings, WebsiteSettings } from "../types";
+import {
+  configuredHref, safeImageField, safeV2Color, sanitizeStorefrontV2Settings, STORE_PALETTE,
+} from "../services/settingsDefaults";
+import { buttonRadiusOf, fontStackOf, shade } from "../services/theme";
+import { canonicalConfiguredStorePath } from "./storeRoutes";
+
+export type V2AppearanceOverrides = Partial<StorefrontV2Settings>;
+
+function luminance(hex: string): number {
+  const raw = safeV2Color(hex, "#000000").slice(1);
+  const full = raw.length === 3 ? raw.split("").map((digit) => digit + digit).join("") : raw;
+  const values = [0, 2, 4].map((index) => {
+    const unit = parseInt(full.slice(index, index + 2), 16) / 255;
+    return unit <= 0.04045 ? unit / 12.92 : ((unit + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
+  });
+  return values[0] * 0.2126 + values[1] * 0.7152 + values[2] * 0.0722;
+}
+
+/** Minimum WCAG AA contrast for small text, including custom dark surfaces. */
+export function contrastRatio(first: string, second: string): number {
+  const a = luminance(first);
+  const b = luminance(second);
+  return (Math.max(a, b) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, b) + 0.05);
+}
+
+function on(bg: string, requested?: string | null): string {
+  const desired = safeV2Color(requested, "");
+  if (desired && contrastRatio(bg, desired) >= 4.5) return desired;
+  return contrastRatio(bg, "#111820") >= contrastRatio(bg, "#ffffff") ? "#111820" : "#ffffff";
+}
+
+const DISPLAY_STACKS = {
+  editorial: '"Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, "Amiri", "Noto Naskh Arabic", serif',
+  modern: '"Inter", "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif',
+  classic: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", "Amiri", "Noto Naskh Arabic", Tahoma, serif',
+} as const;
+const ARABIC_BODY_STACK = '"Noto Sans Arabic", "Cairo", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif';
+const ARABIC_DISPLAY_STACK = '"Noto Naskh Arabic", "Amiri", Tahoma, Arial, serif';
+
+export function adaptV2Appearance(settings: WebsiteSettings, overrides: V2AppearanceOverrides = {}) {
+  // Defend at the renderer too: old SQL validates shared theme fields, but does
+  // not validate V2-only JSON. Invalid stored URLs, enums or CSS never render.
+  const v2 = sanitizeStorefrontV2Settings({ ...settings.storefront_v2, ...overrides });
+  const theme = settings.theme;
+  const bg = safeV2Color(v2.page_bg, safeV2Color(theme.background_color, STORE_PALETTE.background_color));
+  const surface = safeV2Color(v2.surface_bg, safeV2Color(theme.surface_color, bg));
+  const primary = safeV2Color(theme.primary_color, STORE_PALETTE.primary_color);
+  const accent = safeV2Color(v2.accent_color, safeV2Color(theme.accent_color, primary));
+  const header = safeV2Color(v2.header_bg, safeV2Color(theme.secondary_color, surface));
+  const footer = safeV2Color(v2.footer_bg, safeV2Color(theme.secondary_color, primary));
+  const announcement = safeV2Color(v2.announcement_bg, safeV2Color(settings.announcement.bg_color, primary));
+  const hero = safeV2Color(v2.hero_bg, primary);
+  const text = v2.text_color ?? theme.text_color;
+  const muted = v2.muted_text ?? theme.muted_text_color;
+  const button = safeV2Color(v2.button_bg, primary);
+  const badge = safeV2Color(v2.badge_bg, accent);
+  const border = safeV2Color(v2.border_color, shade(bg, contrastRatio(bg, "#111820") > 4.5 ? -0.19 : 0.2));
+  const headerText = on(header, v2.header_text);
+  const bodyFont = v2.body_font === "inherit" ? fontStackOf(theme.font_stack) : fontStackOf(v2.body_font);
+  const displayFont = v2.display_font === "inherit" ? DISPLAY_STACKS.editorial : DISPLAY_STACKS[v2.display_font];
+  const buttonStyle = v2.button_style === "inherit" ? theme.button_style : v2.button_style;
+  const height = v2.logo_height ?? 38;
+  const mobileHeight = v2.mobile_logo_height ?? 38;
+  const headerLogoUrl = safeImageField(luminance(header) < 0.179
+    ? settings.brand.logo_dark_url ?? settings.images.logo_url
+    : settings.images.logo_url);
+  const mobileLogoUrl = v2.mobile_logo_url ?? headerLogoUrl;
+  const variables = {
+    "--v2-bg": bg,
+    "--v2-surface": surface,
+    "--v2-text": on(bg, text),
+    "--v2-muted": on(bg, muted),
+    "--v2-surface-text": on(surface, text),
+    "--v2-surface-muted": on(surface, muted),
+    "--v2-primary": primary,
+    "--v2-primary-text": on(primary),
+    "--v2-accent": accent,
+    "--v2-accent-text": on(bg, accent),
+    "--v2-focus": on(bg, accent),
+    "--v2-border": border,
+    "--v2-header-bg": header,
+    "--v2-header-text": headerText,
+    "--v2-header-accent-text": on(header, accent),
+    "--v2-announcement-bg": announcement,
+    "--v2-announcement-text": on(announcement, v2.announcement_text ?? settings.announcement.text_color),
+    "--v2-footer-bg": footer,
+    "--v2-footer-text": on(footer, v2.footer_text),
+    "--v2-footer-link": on(footer, v2.footer_link ?? v2.footer_text),
+    "--v2-button-bg": button,
+    "--v2-button-text": on(button, v2.button_text),
+    "--v2-badge-bg": badge,
+    "--v2-badge-text": on(badge, v2.badge_text),
+    "--v2-button-radius": `${buttonRadiusOf(buttonStyle, Number.isFinite(theme.corner_radius) ? theme.corner_radius : 4)}px`,
+    "--v2-badge-radius": v2.badge_style === "pill" ? "9999px" : "0px",
+    "--v2-card-radius": `${Math.min(16, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(theme.corner_radius) ? theme.corner_radius : 4))}px`,
+    "--v2-hero-bg": hero,
+    "--v2-hero-text": on(hero, v2.hero_text),
+    "--v2-font-body": bodyFont,
+    "--v2-font-display": displayFont,
+    "--v2-font-arabic-body": v2.body_font === "classic" ? ARABIC_DISPLAY_STACK : ARABIC_BODY_STACK,
+    "--v2-font-arabic-display": v2.display_font === "modern" ? ARABIC_BODY_STACK : ARABIC_DISPLAY_STACK,
+    "--v2-logo-height": `${height}px`,
+    "--v2-mobile-logo-height": `${mobileHeight}px`,
+  } as CSSProperties;
+  return {
+    variables,
+    stickyHeader: v2.sticky_header ?? settings.header.sticky,
+    showSearch: v2.show_search ?? settings.header.search_enabled,
+    showAccount: v2.show_account ?? settings.header.account_enabled,
+    showCart: v2.show_cart ?? settings.header.cart_enabled,
+    showLanguage: v2.show_language,
+    mobileColumns: v2.mobile_columns ?? (settings.product_card.mobile_columns === 1 ? 1 : 2),
+    logoUrl: safeImageField(settings.images.logo_url),
+    headerLogoUrl,
+    mobileLogoUrl,
+  };
+}
+
+/** Stored canonical shop links stay canonical; saved preview links become
+ * canonical too. Validate first and never mutate the merchant's settings. */
+export function v2Href(raw: unknown): string | null {
+  const href = configuredHref(raw);
+  if (!href) return null;
+  if (!href.startsWith("#/")) return href;
+  const path = href.slice(1);
+  if (path.startsWith("//") || path.includes("\\") || [...path].some((char) => char.charCodeAt(0) < 32)) return null;
+  return canonicalConfiguredStorePath(path);
+}

+/** UI-only guards for the opt-in V2 journey. No separate cart, customer store,
+ * price calculator or order writer: the shared providers keep those roles. */
+import type { Product } from "@/modules/products/types";
+import type { CustomerAddress, DeliveryType, DeliveryZone, OnlineOrder, WebsiteSettings } from "../types";
+import type { StoreVariant } from "../services/pricing";
+import { availableToPromise, reservedOf, variantAvailableToPromise } from "../services/availability";
+import { deliveryAreaSupported, deliveryMinimumShortfall, round2 } from "../services/pricing";
+
+export const V2_RECEIPT_KEY = "alyq.v2.confirmation.session";
+const RECEIPT_LIFETIME_MS = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
+export interface V2ReceiptPair { order: string; phone: string; at: number }
+type ReceiptStore = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem">;
+
+/** A tab-scoped lookup pair, never an unverified order body. On refresh the
+ * existing lookupOrder(reference, phone) rechecks both halves. A reference by
+ * itself can never reveal a customer record. */
+export function rememberV2Receipt(order: OnlineOrder, storage: ReceiptStore): void {
+  try {
+    storage.setItem(V2_RECEIPT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ order: order.order_number,
+      phone: order.customer_phone, at: Date.now() } satisfies V2ReceiptPair));
+  } catch { /* blocked/private storage: tracking remains the safe fallback */ }
+}
+export function readV2Receipt(storage: ReceiptStore, now = Date.now()): V2ReceiptPair | null {
+  try {
+    const raw = storage.getItem(V2_RECEIPT_KEY);
+    if (!raw) return null;
+    const pair: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
+    if (!pair || typeof pair !== "object") return null;
+    const value = pair as Partial<V2ReceiptPair>;
+    if (typeof value.order !== "string" || value.order.length < 3 || value.order.length > 80 ||
+      typeof value.phone !== "string" || value.phone.length < 5 || value.phone.length > 40 ||
+      !Number.isFinite(value.at) || (value.at ?? 0) > now || now - (value.at ?? 0) > RECEIPT_LIFETIME_MS) {
+      storage.removeItem(V2_RECEIPT_KEY);
+      return null;
+    }
+    return value as V2ReceiptPair;
+  } catch { return null; }
+}
+export function forgetV2Receipt(storage: ReceiptStore): void {
+  try { storage.removeItem(V2_RECEIPT_KEY); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
+}
+
+export interface V2CheckoutFields {
+  name: string;
+  phone: string;
+  address: CustomerAddress | null;
+  deliveryType: DeliveryType;
+  deliveryZoneId: string | null;
+  goodsTotal: number;
+  blockedLines: number;
+}
+/** Same Egyptian shopper-phone, area and minimum rules the legacy checkout
+ * already presents. The place-order RPC independently enforces the real rules.
+ * Never send a browser-calculated price as an order authority. */
+export function v2CheckoutIssues(fields: V2CheckoutFields, settings: WebsiteSettings,
+  zones: readonly DeliveryZone[]) {
+  const activeZones = zones.filter((zone) => zone.enabled);
+  const zone = activeZones.find((entry) => entry.id === fields.deliveryZoneId) ?? null;
+  const delivery = fields.deliveryType === "delivery";
+  const phone = fields.phone.replace(/\s+/g, "");
+  const address = fields.address;
+  const missingAddress = delivery && (!address?.city.trim() || !address?.area.trim() || !address?.street.trim());
+  const typedArea = Boolean(address?.city.trim() || address?.area.trim());
+  const minimum = delivery && zone ? zone.minimum_order_amount : settings.delivery.minimum_order ?? 0;
+  const shortfall = delivery && zone
+    ? round2(Math.max(zone.minimum_order_amount - fields.goodsTotal, 0))
+    : deliveryMinimumShortfall(settings.delivery, fields.deliveryType, fields.goodsTotal);
+  return {
+    name: !fields.name.trim(),
+    phone: !/^01[0-25]\d{8}$/.test(phone),
+    address: Boolean(missingAddress),
+    zone: delivery && activeZones.length > 0 && !zone,
+    area: delivery && !zone && typedArea &&
+      !deliveryAreaSupported(settings.delivery, address?.city ?? "", address?.area ?? ""),
+    fulfilment: !settings.delivery.enabled && !settings.delivery.pickup_enabled ||
+      (delivery ? !settings.delivery.enabled : !settings.delivery.pickup_enabled),
+    payment: !settings.delivery.cod_enabled && !settings.delivery.instapay_enabled,
+    stock: fields.blockedLines > 0,
+    shortfall,
+    minimum,
+    validZone: zone,
+  };
+}
+
+export type V2ReorderLine = { product_id: string; variant_id: string | null; quantity: number };
+export interface V2ReorderPlan { ready: V2ReorderLine[]; unavailable: string[] }
+/** Match each historic line to the SAME currently sellable product/variant UUID
+ * before asking the shared cart to add it. Stock tracking is required by the
+ * V2 checkout too; a currently untracked product is not a valid reorder line.
+ * Keep valid lines separate so the shopper can opt for a partial reorder while
+ * the unavailable SKUs remain visible. The server rechecks everything at order. */
+export function planV2Reorder(order: OnlineOrder, products: readonly Product[],
+  variants: readonly StoreVariant[], heldProducts: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map(),
+  heldVariants: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map(),
+  cart: readonly V2ReorderLine[] = []): V2ReorderPlan {
+  const byProduct = new Map(products.map((product) => [product.id, product]));
+  const byVariant = new Map(variants.map((variant) => [variant.id, variant]));
+  const unavailable: string[] = [];
+  const ready: V2ReorderLine[] = [];
+  const planned = new Map<string, number>();
+  for (const item of order.items) {
+    const product = byProduct.get(item.product_id);
+    const variant = item.variant_id ? byVariant.get(item.variant_id) : null;
+    const key = `${item.product_id}::${item.variant_id ?? ""}`;
+    const existing = cart.filter((line) => line.product_id === item.product_id &&
+      (line.variant_id ?? null) === (item.variant_id ?? null))
+      .reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0);
+    const available = product?.stock_tracking_enabled
+      ? variant ? variantAvailableToPromise(variant, heldVariants.get(variant.id) ?? 0)
+        : availableToPromise(product, reservedOf(heldProducts, product.id))
+      : null;
+    if (!product || !product.active || !product.show_on_website || !product.stock_tracking_enabled ||
+      !Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity <= 0 ||
+      (product.variants_enabled ? !variant || !variant.active || variant.product_id !== product.id
+        : Boolean(item.variant_id)) || available === null ||
+      available < existing + (planned.get(key) ?? 0) + item.quantity) {
+      unavailable.push(item.sku);
+      continue;
+    }
+    ready.push({ product_id: product.id, variant_id: variant?.id ?? null, quantity: item.quantity });
+    planned.set(key, (planned.get(key) ?? 0) + item.quantity);
+  }
+  return { ready, unavailable };
+}

+/** Compatibility for links saved while V2 lived at #/store/v2. The public
+ * storefront has one page tree at #/store; unknown preview paths go home rather
+ * than exposing the old presentation or inventing a second routing surface. */
+const PREVIEW = "/store/v2";
+const PAGES = new Set(["/cart", "/checkout", "/confirmation", "/track", "/account", "/about", "/contact"]);
+const CATALOG_KEYS = new Set(["q", "sort", "category", "brand", "color", "size", "size_label",
+  "min", "max", "availability", "offer"]);
+const ACCOUNT_TABS = new Set(["profile", "addresses", "wishlist", "orders"]);
+
+export function isPreviewStorePath(pathname: string): boolean {
+  return pathname === PREVIEW || pathname.startsWith(`${PREVIEW}/`);
+}
+
+export function canonicalStorePathname(pathname: string): string {
+  if (pathname === PREVIEW) return "/store";
+  if (!pathname.startsWith(`${PREVIEW}/`)) return pathname;
+  const suffix = pathname.slice(PREVIEW.length);
+  if (suffix === "/products" || /^\/products\/[^/]+$/.test(suffix) || PAGES.has(suffix)) {
+    return `/store${suffix}`;
+  }
+  return "/store";
+}
+
+/** Preserve only query state that a former preview page actually consumes.
+ * Never copy a phone number or arbitrary parameters from an old tracking URL
+ * into a new shareable canonical URL. The normal #/store links are unchanged. */
+export function canonicalPreviewSearch(pathname: string, search: string): string {
+  if (!isPreviewStorePath(pathname)) return search;
+  const target = canonicalStorePathname(pathname);
+  const allowed = target === "/store/products" || /^\/store\/products\/[^/]+$/.test(target)
+    ? CATALOG_KEYS : target === "/store/track" ? new Set(["number"])
+      : target === "/store/account" ? new Set(["tab"]) : new Set<string>();
+  const safe = new URLSearchParams();
+  for (const [key, value] of new URLSearchParams(search)) {
+    if (!allowed.has(key) || value.length > 200 || safe.has(key) || [...safe].length >= 12) continue;
+    if (key === "tab" && !ACCOUNT_TABS.has(value)) continue;
+    if (key === "number" && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$/.test(value)) continue;
+    safe.set(key, value);
+  }
+  const result = safe.toString();
+  return result ? `?${result}` : "";
+}
+
+/** Configured hash links have already passed configuredHref's scheme checks.
+ * Preserve canonical links, but normalise and limit former preview URLs. */
+export function canonicalConfiguredStorePath(path: string): string {
+  const boundary = path.search(/[?#]/);
+  const pathname = boundary < 0 ? path : path.slice(0, boundary);
+  if (!isPreviewStorePath(pathname)) return path;
+  const query = path.indexOf("?");
+  const end = path.indexOf("#");
+  const search = query < 0 || (end >= 0 && end < query) ? ""
+    : path.slice(query, end < 0 ? undefined : end);
+  return canonicalStorePathname(pathname) + canonicalPreviewSearch(pathname, search);
+}

+/** V2's view over the existing, published exact shelves. No product rollup,
+ * inferred size matrix, fixed clothing-size list or alternate stock ledger.
+ */
+import type { StoreVariant } from "../services/pricing";
+import { colorGroupsOf, sortStoreVariants } from "../services/pricing";
+import { storeSizeLabel } from "../services/variantLabel";
+import { variantAvailableToPromise } from "../services/availability";
+
+export function sizeKeyOf(variant: Pick<StoreVariant, "size" | "size_label">): string {
+  if (variant.size !== null) return `number:${variant.size}`;
+  const label = variant.size_label?.trim();
+  return label ? `label:${label.toLocaleLowerCase()}` : "";
+}
+
+export function variantModel(
+  published: readonly StoreVariant[],
+  holds: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map(),
+  orderable = true,
+) {
+  const variants = sortStoreVariants(published.filter((variant) => variant.active));
+  const groups = colorGroupsOf(variants);
+  const hasColors = groups.some((group) => Boolean(group.color_key || group.color_ar || group.color_en));
+  const hasSizes = variants.some((variant) => sizeKeyOf(variant) !== "");
+  const remaining = (variant: StoreVariant): number => orderable
+    ? variantAvailableToPromise(variant, holds.get(variant.id) ?? 0)
+    : 0;
+  const sellable = variants.filter((variant) => remaining(variant) > 0);
+
+  return {
+    groups,
+    variants,
+    hasColors,
+    hasSizes,
+    sellable,
+    remaining,
+    /** A colour change never silently inherits another colour's size. */
+    exact(colorKey: string | null, sizeKey: string | null): StoreVariant | null {
+      if (hasColors && colorKey === null) return null;
+      if (hasSizes && sizeKey === null) return null;
+      return variants.find((variant) =>
+        variant.color_key === (colorKey ?? "") &&
+        sizeKeyOf(variant) === (sizeKey ?? "") &&
+        remaining(variant) > 0,
+      ) ?? null;
+    },
+    /** Never auto-select among multiple published options, even if just one is in stock. */
+    soleQuickAdd(): StoreVariant | null {
+      return variants.length === 1 && sellable.length === 1 ? sellable[0] : null;
+    },
+    /** Existing rows only: sold-out sizes remain visible rather than disappearing. */
+    sizesFor(colorKey: string | null) {
+      return groups.find((group) => group.color_key === (colorKey ?? ""))?.variants.map((variant) => ({
+        variant,
+        key: sizeKeyOf(variant),
+        label: storeSizeLabel(variant.size, variant.size_label),
+        available: remaining(variant),
+      })) ?? [];
+    },
+  };
+}
