+/** Presentation-only price and image selectors. The original pricing helpers
+ * are used without modifying placement/payment logic. Checkout and the SQL
+ * place_online_order RPC remain authoritative over all discounts and holds.
+ */
+import type { Product } from "@/modules/products/types";
+import type { Campaign, ProductContent, Promotion, PromotionTarget } from "../types";
+import type { StoreVariant } from "../services/pricing";
+import { campaignFor, promotionUnitPrice, variantUnitPriceOf, unitPriceOf } from "../services/pricing";
+import { variantAvailableToPromise } from "../services/availability";
+import { searchCatalog, variantMatchesCatalogFilters, type CatalogContext, type CatalogFilters, type CatalogProduct } from "../services/catalogQuery";
+
+export function v2Price(
+  product: Product,
+  variants: readonly StoreVariant[],
+  campaigns: readonly Campaign[],
+  promotions: readonly Promotion[],
+  targets: readonly PromotionTarget[],
+  selected: StoreVariant | null = null,
+  holds: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map(),
+) {
+  const matching = product.variants_enabled ? variants.filter((variant) => variant.active &&
+    variantAvailableToPromise(variant, holds.get(variant.id) ?? 0) > 0) : [];
+  // Only a selected exact shelf or a published combination supplies its price;
+  // never present a parent-level price as a substitute for a sold-out variant.
+  const list = product.variants_enabled ? (selected ? [selected]
+    : matching.length ? matching : variants.filter((v) => v.active)) : [null];
+  const targetMap = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
+  for (const target of targets) {
+    const set = targetMap.get(target.promotion_id) ?? new Set<string>();
+    set.add(`${target.target_kind}:${target.target_id}`);
+    targetMap.set(target.promotion_id, set);
+  }
+  const prices = list.map((variant) => {
+    const base = variant?.price_override ?? product.selling_price;
+    const campaign = campaignFor(product.id, campaigns);
+    const campaignPrice = variant
+      ? variantUnitPriceOf(variant, product.selling_price, campaign)
+      : unitPriceOf(product.selling_price, campaign);
+    const offer = promotionUnitPrice(
+      product.id, variant?.id ?? null, product.category_id, campaignPrice, promotions, targetMap,
+    );
+    return { id: variant?.id ?? null, price: Math.min(offer.unit, campaignPrice), list: base };
+  });
+  const lowest = prices.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)[0] ?? {
+    id: null, price: product.selling_price, list: product.selling_price,
+  };
+  return { ...lowest, from: product.variants_enabled && list.length > 1 };
+}
+
+/** The V2 tile price is the V2 price/filter/sort authority in the browser.
+ * Search, category, stock and brand still come from the shared catalogue query.
+ * All of this is advisory; order placement recomputes on the server.
+ */
+export function v2CatalogResults(
+  products: readonly Product[],
+  filters: CatalogFilters,
+  context: CatalogContext,
+  campaigns: readonly Campaign[],
+  promotions: readonly Promotion[],
+  targets: readonly PromotionTarget[],
+  offerOnly = false,
+): CatalogProduct[] {
+  const base = searchCatalog(products, { ...filters, minPrice: null, maxPrice: null, limit: null }, context);
+  const narrowed = Boolean(filters.color || filters.size !== null || filters.sizeLabel);
+  const priced = base.map((entry) => {
+    const variants = context.variants?.get(entry.product.id) ?? [];
+    const shown = narrowed ? variants.filter((variant) => variantMatchesCatalogFilters(variant, filters)) : variants;
+    const view = v2Price(entry.product, shown, campaigns, promotions, targets, null, context.reservedVariant);
+    const available = narrowed && entry.product.stock_tracking_enabled
+      ? shown.reduce((count, variant) => count + variantAvailableToPromise(variant,
+        context.reservedVariant?.get(variant.id) ?? 0), 0) : entry.available;
+    return { entry: narrowed ? { ...entry, available, inStock: available !== null && available > 0 } : entry, view };
+  });
+  const filtered = priced.filter(({ view }) =>
+    (filters.minPrice === null || view.price >= filters.minPrice) &&
+    (filters.maxPrice === null || view.price <= filters.maxPrice) &&
+    (!offerOnly || view.price < view.list),
+  );
+  if (filters.sort === "price_asc" || filters.sort === "price_desc") {
+    const direction = filters.sort === "price_asc" ? 1 : -1;
+    filtered.sort((a, b) => direction * (a.view.price - b.view.price) ||
+      (a.entry.product.name_en || a.entry.product.name_ar).localeCompare(
+        b.entry.product.name_en || b.entry.product.name_ar, "en"));
+  }
+  const entries = filtered.map(({ entry }) => entry);
+  return filters.limit !== null && filters.limit > 0 ? entries.slice(0, filters.limit) : entries;
+}
+
+export function v2Gallery(product: Pick<Product, "image_url" | "images">, content: ProductContent | null) {
+  const all = [product.image_url, ...product.images, ...(content?.media ?? [])
+    .slice().sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order).map((media) => media.url)];
+  return [...new Set(all.filter((url): url is string => Boolean(url?.trim())))];
+}

+test("cart controls use exact variant IDs and never borrow a sibling's stock", () => {
+  const gold = line({ product_id: "ring", variant_id: "gold-17", sku: "G17", qty: 1, max_qty: 2, color_en: "Gold", size: 17 });
+  const silver = line({ product_id: "ring", variant_id: "silver-17", sku: "S17", qty: 1, max_qty: 5, color_en: "Silver", size: 17 });
+  assert.notEqual(lineKey(gold), lineKey(silver));
+  let cart = addCartLine([], gold).lines;
+  cart = addCartLine(cart, silver).lines;
+  assert.equal(cart.length, 2, "same product and size but different variant IDs do not merge");
+  cart = addCartLine(cart, gold).lines;
+  assert.equal(cart[0].qty, 2);
+  assert.equal(addCartLine(cart, gold).added, false, "third Gold/17 refused although Silver has five");
+  cart = changeCartQuantity(cart, lineKey(silver), 1);
+  assert.deepEqual(cart.map((entry) => entry.qty), [2, 2], "increase changes only the selected shelf");
+  cart = discountCartLine(cart, lineKey(gold), { type: "fixed", value: 3 });
+  assert.equal(cart[0].item_discount?.value, 3);
+  assert.notEqual(cart[1].item_discount?.value, 3);
+  cart = changeCartQuantity(cart, lineKey(gold), -1);
+  cart = changeCartQuantity(cart, lineKey(gold), -1);

+  assert.deepEqual(removeCartLine(cart, lineKey(silver)), [], "remove acts on the exact line");
+});

+++ b/src/modules/pos/services/cartOperations.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { lineKey, type CartDiscount, type CartLine } from "../types";
+
+/** A cart line is identified by the *variant ID*, never by its displayed size. */
+export function addCartLine(lines: readonly CartLine[], candidate: CartLine): { lines: CartLine[]; added: boolean } {
+  const key = lineKey(candidate);
+  const current = lines.find((line) => lineKey(line) === key);
+  if (current) {
+    // Use the latest shelf limit. A second scan cannot borrow a sibling's stock.
+    if (current.qty >= candidate.max_qty) return { lines: [...lines], added: false };
+    return {
+      lines: lines.map((line) => lineKey(line) === key
+        ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1, max_qty: candidate.max_qty }
+        : line),
+      added: true,
+    };
+  }
+  if (candidate.max_qty < 1) return { lines: [...lines], added: false };
+  return { lines: [...lines, candidate], added: true };
+}
+
+export function changeCartQuantity(lines: readonly CartLine[], key: string, change: 1 | -1): CartLine[] {
+  return lines.flatMap((line) => {
+    if (lineKey(line) !== key) return [line];
+    const qty = line.qty + change;
+    return qty < 1 ? [] : [{ ...line, qty: Math.min(qty, line.max_qty) }];
+  });
+}
+
+export function removeCartLine(lines: readonly CartLine[], key: string): CartLine[] {
+  return lines.filter((line) => lineKey(line) !== key);
+}
+
+export function discountCartLine(lines: readonly CartLine[], key: string, discount: CartDiscount): CartLine[] {
+  return lines.map((line) => lineKey(line) === key ? { ...line, item_discount: discount } : line);
+}

+    (err: unknown) => (err as { code?: string }).code === "FORBIDDEN",
+    "viewer cannot edit a combination even when bypassing the form");
+  signIn("admin");
+});

+import {
+  colorKeyOf, generateCombinations, sizeLabelOf, suggestVariantSku,
+  type ProductVariant, type VariantColorDraft,
+} from "../variants";
+
+export type ProductVariantMode = "none" | "colors" | "sizes" | "colors_sizes";
+export interface VariantColorRow {
+  /** Stable UI identity. For saved colours this is the original color_key. */
+  id: string;
+  color_ar: string;
+  color_en: string;
+  color_hex: string;
+  image_url: string;
+}
+export interface ProductVariantDraft {
+  id: string;
+  persistedId: string | null;
+  color_id: string;
+  /** Saved colour identity: NEVER recomputed when a label is renamed. */
+  color_key: string;
+  color_ar: string;
+  color_en: string;
+  color_hex: string;
+  size: string;
+  size_label: string;
+  sku: string;
+  barcode: string;
+  stock_quantity: string;
+  low_stock_level: string;
+  price_override: string;
+  cost_override: string;
+  /** Optional per-combination image override. New rows inherit their colour URL. */
+  image_url: string;
+  active: boolean;
+}
+export interface ProductVariantFormValue {
+  mode: ProductVariantMode;
+  colors: VariantColorRow[];
+  sizes: number[];
+  rows: ProductVariantDraft[];
+}
+export const EMPTY_PRODUCT_VARIANT_FORM: ProductVariantFormValue = {
+  mode: "none", colors: [], sizes: [], rows: [],
+};
+
+export const usesColors = (mode: ProductVariantMode) => mode === "colors" || mode === "colors_sizes";
+export const usesSizes = (mode: ProductVariantMode) => mode === "sizes" || mode === "colors_sizes";
+
+const pairKey = (colorId: string, size: number | null, label = "") =>
+  `${colorId}|${size === null ? `label:${label}` : `number:${sizeLabelOf(size, null)}`}`;
+const rowKey = (row: ProductVariantDraft) => pairKey(
+  row.color_id,
+  row.size.trim() ? Number(row.size.replace(",", ".")) : null,
+  row.size_label,
+);
+
+/** New combinations are generated as the employee edits chips/rows — no second "generate" step. */
+export function reconcileVariantDraft(value: ProductVariantFormValue, productSku: string): ProductVariantFormValue {
+  if (value.mode === "none") return value; // a mode change never silently erases work
+  const colors = usesColors(value.mode)
+    ? value.colors.filter((row) => (row.color_en || row.color_ar).trim())
+    : [];
+  const sizes = usesSizes(value.mode) ? value.sizes : [];
+  if ((usesColors(value.mode) && !colors.length) || (usesSizes(value.mode) && !sizes.length)) {
+    return { ...value, rows: value.rows.filter((row) => row.persistedId) };
+  }
+  const byPair = new Map(value.rows.map((row) => [rowKey(row), row]));
+  const taken = value.rows.map((row) => row.sku);
+  const combinations = generateCombinations(
+    colors.map((row): VariantColorDraft => ({ color_ar: row.color_ar || null, color_en: row.color_en || null, color_hex: row.color_hex || null })),
+    sizes,
+  );
+  const rows = combinations.map((combination) => {
+    // The generator de-duplicates normalized colour keys; use the same identity
+    // here. Duplicate labels are reported by validateVariantDraft, not saved.
+    const color = combination.color ? colors.find((row) => colorKeyOf(row) === combination.color_key) : null;
+    const colorId = color?.id ?? "";
+    const previous = byPair.get(pairKey(colorId, combination.size, combination.size_label ?? ""));
+    if (previous) return {
+      ...previous, color_ar: color?.color_ar ?? "", color_en: color?.color_en ?? "",
+      color_hex: color?.color_hex ?? "",
+    };
+    const sku = suggestVariantSku(productSku, combination.color, combination.size, combination.size_label, taken);
+    taken.push(sku);
+    return {
+      id: `draft:${colorId}:${combination.size ?? combination.size_label ?? ""}`,
+      // A renamed saved colour keeps its original identity even for NEW sizes.
+      // Otherwise Gold → Yellow Gold would put size 19 on a different colour
+      // shelf than the existing sizes 17/18, and reopen the editor as a
+      // duplicate-label draft that cannot be saved.
+      persistedId: null, color_id: colorId,
+      color_key: colorId && !colorId.startsWith("color:") ? colorId : "",
+      color_ar: color?.color_ar ?? "", color_en: color?.color_en ?? "",
+      color_hex: color?.color_hex ?? "",
+      size: combination.size === null ? "" : sizeLabelOf(combination.size, null),
+      size_label: combination.size_label ?? "",
+      sku, barcode: "", stock_quantity: "0", low_stock_level: "0",
+      price_override: "", cost_override: "", image_url: "", active: true,
+    } satisfies ProductVariantDraft;
+  });
+  // Existing combinations removed from the chips are *never* deleted here.
+  // The persisted row remains visible, and the editor prevents removing an
+  // option with saved shelves. Archiving/deletion has a separate guarded path.
+  rows.push(...value.rows.filter((row) => row.persistedId && !rows.some((next) => next.id === row.id)));
+  return { ...value, rows };
+}
+
+/** Reuse the same simple controls for Edit Product; no loss of SKUs or stock. */
+export function variantDraftFromSaved(variants: readonly ProductVariant[]): ProductVariantFormValue {
+  if (!variants.length) return EMPTY_PRODUCT_VARIANT_FORM;
+  const active = variants.filter((row) => row.active);
+  const available = active.length ? active : variants;
+  const hasColors = available.some((row) => Boolean(row.color_key));
+  const hasSizes = available.some((row) => row.size !== null || Boolean(row.size_label));
+  const mode: ProductVariantMode = hasColors && hasSizes ? "colors_sizes" : hasColors ? "colors" : "sizes";
+  const colors: VariantColorRow[] = [];
+  const sizes: number[] = [];
+  for (const row of available) {
+    if (hasColors && row.color_key && !colors.some((color) => color.id === row.color_key)) {
+      colors.push({ id: row.color_key, color_ar: row.color_ar ?? "", color_en: row.color_en ?? "",
+        color_hex: row.color_hex ?? "", image_url: row.image_url ?? "" });
+    }
+    if (row.size !== null && !sizes.includes(row.size)) sizes.push(row.size);
+  }
+  return {
+    mode, colors, sizes: sizes.sort((a, b) => a - b),
+    rows: variants.map((row) => ({
+      id: row.id, persistedId: row.id, color_id: row.color_key, color_key: row.color_key,
+      color_ar: row.color_ar ?? "", color_en: row.color_en ?? "", color_hex: row.color_hex ?? "",
+      size: row.size === null ? "" : sizeLabelOf(row.size, null), size_label: row.size_label ?? "",
+      sku: row.sku, barcode: row.barcode ?? "", stock_quantity: String(row.stock_quantity),
+      low_stock_level: String(row.low_stock_level),
+      price_override: row.price_override === null ? "" : String(row.price_override),
+      cost_override: row.cost_override === null ? "" : String(row.cost_override),
+      image_url: row.image_url ?? "", active: row.active,
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+/** Stock total follows exact shelves (including an archived shelf if it still holds stock). */
+export function variantDraftTotal(rows: readonly ProductVariantDraft[]): number {
+  return rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (Number(row.stock_quantity) || 0), 0);
+}
+
+/** Refuse bad drafts *before* creating a product (a partly written product is not a form error). */
+export function validateVariantDraft(value: ProductVariantFormValue, productSku: string, productBarcode = ""): string | null {
+  if (value.mode === "none") return null;
+  if (usesColors(value.mode)) {
+    if (!value.colors.length || value.colors.some((c) => !(c.color_en || c.color_ar).trim())) return "colorsRequired";
+    const keys = value.colors.map(colorKeyOf);
+    if (new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) return "duplicateColor";
+    if (value.colors.some((c) => c.color_hex.trim() && !/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(c.color_hex.trim()))) return "invalidColor";
+  }
+  // Legacy One Size / textual-size rows have no numeric chip; they must remain
+  // editable without inventing a new numeric combination just to press Save.
+  if (usesSizes(value.mode) && !value.sizes.length &&
+      !value.rows.some((row) => row.persistedId && row.size_label.trim())) return "sizesRequired";
+  if (value.rows.length === 0) return "nothingToGenerate";
+  const codes = new Set([productSku.trim().toUpperCase()]);
+  const barcodes = new Set(productBarcode.trim() ? [productBarcode.trim().toUpperCase()] : []);
+  for (const row of value.rows) {
+    const sku = row.sku.trim().toUpperCase();
+    if (!sku || codes.has(sku) || sku.length > 40) return "duplicateSku";
+    codes.add(sku);
+    const barcode = row.barcode.trim().toUpperCase();
+    if (barcode && (barcodes.has(barcode) || barcode.length > 80)) return "duplicateBarcode";
+    if (barcode) barcodes.add(barcode);
+    if (!/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(row.stock_quantity) ||
+        !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(row.low_stock_level)) return "invalidQuantity";
+    if (!row.active && Number(row.stock_quantity) > 0 && !row.persistedId) return "inactiveStock";
+    for (const field of [row.price_override, row.cost_override]) {
+      if (field.trim() && (!Number.isFinite(Number(field)) || Number(field) < 0)) return "invalidPrice";
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}

+-- A variant-enabled product must keep a sellable combination. Migration 0043
+-- checked the NUMBER of rows before delete, but an archived sibling does not
+-- make the last active shelf sellable. Lock the parent before checking active
+-- siblings: concurrent archive/delete operations on different shelves then
+-- serialize instead of each seeing the other shelf as still active.
+-- Existing RLS granted direct DELETE and direct UPDATE(active) to authenticated;
+-- both skip these lifecycle RPCs. Keep metadata editing and the Phase 43
+-- adjust_stock-only shelf update, but reserve deletion and active changes for
+-- the guarded SECURITY DEFINER functions. Owner-run conversion, stocktake and
+-- factory-reset functions retain their own explicit semantics.
+revoke update, delete on table public.product_variants from public, anon, authenticated;
+grant update (sku, barcode, color_key, color_ar, color_en, color_hex, size, size_label,
+              image_url, price_override, cost_override, stock_quantity,
+              low_stock_level, sort_order)
+  on table public.product_variants to authenticated;
+
+create or replace function public.set_variant_active(p_variant_id uuid, p_active boolean)
+returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_parent_id uuid;
+  v_variant   public.product_variants%rowtype;
+  v_product   public.products%rowtype;
+  v_others    integer;
+begin
+  if not public.can('edit_product') then
+    raise exception 'Archiving a variant requires the edit_product capability'
+      using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';
+  end if;
+
+  select product_id into v_parent_id from public.product_variants where id = p_variant_id;
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'Variant % not found', p_variant_id using errcode = 'foreign_key_violation';
+  end if;
+  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_parent_id for update;
+  select * into v_variant from public.product_variants where id = p_variant_id for update;
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'Variant % not found', p_variant_id using errcode = 'foreign_key_violation';
+  end if;
+  if v_product.id is null or v_variant.product_id <> v_product.id then
+    raise exception 'Variant % changed product during archive', p_variant_id using errcode = 'check_violation';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_variant.active = p_active then
+    return jsonb_build_object('variant_id', v_variant.id, 'active', v_variant.active, 'changed', false);
+  end if;
+
+  if not p_active and v_product.variants_enabled then
+    select count(*) into v_others
+      from public.product_variants
+     where product_id = v_variant.product_id and id <> v_variant.id and active;
+    if v_others = 0 then
+      raise exception 'Product % would have nothing left to sell — add or reactivate another combination first',
+        v_product.sku using errcode = 'check_violation';
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  update public.product_variants set active = p_active, updated_at = now() where id = v_variant.id;
+  return jsonb_build_object('variant_id', v_variant.id, 'active', p_active, 'changed', true,
+                            'sku', v_variant.sku);
+end
+$$;
+
+create or replace function public.delete_variant(p_variant_id uuid)
+returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_parent_id uuid;
+  v_variant   public.product_variants%rowtype;
+  v_product   public.products%rowtype;
+  v_refs      record;
+  v_siblings  integer;
+  v_active    integer;
+  v_counts    integer;
+begin
+  if not public.can('delete_product') then
+    raise exception 'Deleting a variant requires the delete_product capability'
+      using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';
+  end if;
+
+  select product_id into v_parent_id from public.product_variants where id = p_variant_id;
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'Variant % not found', p_variant_id using errcode = 'foreign_key_violation';
+  end if;
+  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_parent_id for update;
+  select * into v_variant from public.product_variants where id = p_variant_id for update;
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'Variant % not found', p_variant_id using errcode = 'foreign_key_violation';
+  end if;
+  if v_product.id is null or v_variant.product_id <> v_product.id then
+    raise exception 'Variant % changed product during deletion', p_variant_id using errcode = 'check_violation';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_product.variants_enabled then
+    select count(*), count(*) filter (where active)
+      into v_siblings, v_active
+      from public.product_variants
+     where product_id = v_variant.product_id and id <> v_variant.id;
+    if v_siblings = 0 or (v_variant.active and v_active = 0) then
+      raise exception 'Product % would have nothing left to sell — add or reactivate another combination first',
+        v_product.sku using errcode = 'check_violation';
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  select * into v_refs from public.variant_reference_counts(p_variant_id);
+  if coalesce(v_refs.total, 0) > 0 then
+    raise exception 'Variant % is named by % historical record(s) — archive it instead of deleting',
+      v_variant.sku, v_refs.total using errcode = 'restrict_violation';
+  end if;
+  -- 0060 added stocktake snapshots with an ON DELETE SET NULL FK for the
+  -- admin danger-zone wipe. The normal delete RPC must KEEP its explicit
+  -- stocktake-history refusal, even though that FK would allow the removal.
+  select count(*) into v_counts from public.stocktake_lines where variant_id = p_variant_id;
+  if v_counts > 0 then
+    raise exception 'Variant % is named by a stocktake and cannot be deleted; archive it instead',
+      v_variant.sku using errcode = 'restrict_violation';
+  end if;
+
+  delete from public.product_variants where id = v_variant.id;
+  return jsonb_build_object('variant_id', v_variant.id, 'sku', v_variant.sku, 'deleted', true);
+end
+$$;
+
+comment on function public.delete_variant(uuid) is
+  'Deletes an unreferenced combination (sales, returns, stocktake history). A variant product must retain an active shelf even if archived siblings exist; archive/delete checks serialize on the product row.';
+comment on function public.set_variant_active(uuid, boolean) is
+  'Archives/reactivates one shelf. Refuses the last active shelf and serializes with delete_variant on the product row.';

+-- Use a zero-stock, unreferenced product, so history does not mask the rule.

+declare
+  v_admin   uuid := '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
+  v_product uuid := '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000061a0';

+  v_silver  uuid := '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000061a2';
+begin
+  perform pg_temp.become(v_admin);
+  insert into public.products (id, sku, name_ar, name_en, category_id,

+  values (v_product, 'SCN-LAST-ACTIVE', 'اختبار آخر رف', 'Last active shelf',
+          '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1', 100, 50, 0, false);
+  insert into public.product_variants (id, product_id, sku, color_en, size, stock_quantity, active)
+  values (v_gold, v_product, 'SCN-LAST-GOLD', 'Gold', 17, 0, true),
+         (v_silver, v_product, 'SCN-LAST-SILVER', 'Silver', 17, 0, true);
+  perform public.enable_product_variants(v_product,
+    jsonb_build_object(v_gold::text, 0, v_silver::text, 0), v_admin::text, 'Amina Admin');
+  perform public.set_variant_active(v_silver, false);
+

+  -- UPDATE(active) or DELETE even when its user holds edit/delete_product.
+  update public.product_variants set color_en = 'Gold' where id = v_gold;
+  begin
+    update public.product_variants set active = false where id = v_gold;
+    raise exception 'direct active UPDATE bypassed the guarded archive RPC';
+  exception when insufficient_privilege then null;
+  end;
+  begin
+    delete from public.product_variants where id = v_gold;
+    raise exception 'direct DELETE bypassed the guarded delete RPC';
+  exception when insufficient_privilege then null;
+  end;
+
+  begin
+    perform public.delete_variant(v_gold);
+    raise exception 'an archived sibling allowed the last active shelf to be deleted';
+  exception when check_violation then null;
+  end;
+  begin
+    perform public.set_variant_active(v_gold, false);
+    raise exception 'an archived sibling allowed the last active shelf to be archived';
+  exception when check_violation then null;
+  end;
+  if (select count(*) from public.product_variants where product_id = v_product and active) <> 1 then
+    raise exception 'last-active refusal changed the available shelves';
+  end if;
+
+  perform public.set_variant_active(v_silver, true);
+  perform public.delete_variant(v_gold);
+  if (select count(*) from public.product_variants where product_id = v_product and active) <> 1 then
+    raise exception 'safe unreferenced delete should leave one active sibling';
+  end if;
+  begin

+  exception when check_violation then null;
+  end;

+  if exists (select 1 from public.products where id = v_product) then
+    raise exception 'last-active fixture was not cleaned up';
+  end if;
+  raise notice 'variant lifecycle (0061) — archived siblings cannot hide a last-active delete or archive; reactivation permits safe deletion and the remaining shelf stays sellable';
+end
+$$;
